_autoconfirm_picking(self):\n        \"\"\" Automatically run `action_confirm` on `self` if one of the\n        picking's move was added after the initial\n        call to `action_confirm`. Note that `action_confirm` will only work on draft moves.\n        \"\"\"\n        for picking in self:\n            if picking.state in ('done', 'cancel'):\n                continue\n            if not picking.move_ids and not picking.package_level_ids:\n                continue\n            if any(move.additional for move in picking.move_ids):\n                picking.action_confirm()\n        to_confirm = self.move_ids.filtered(lambda m: m.state == 'draft' and m.quantity)\n        to_confirm._action_confirm()\n\n    def _get_moves_to_backorder(self):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        return self.move_ids.filtered(lambda x: x.state not in ('done', 'cancel'))\n\n    def _create_backorder_picking(self):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        return self.copy({\n            'name': '/',\n            'move_ids': [],\n            'move_line_ids': [],\n            'backorder_id': self.id,\n            'return_id': self.return_id.id,\n        })\n\n    def _create_backorder(self, backorder_moves=None):\n        \"\"\" This method is called when the user chose to create a backorder. It will create a new\n        picking, the backorder, and move the stock.moves that are not `done` or `cancel` into it.\n        \"\"\"\n        backorders = self.env['stock.picking']\n        bo_to_assign = self.env['stock.picking']\n        for picking in self:\n            if backorder_moves:\n                moves_to_backorder = backorder_moves.filtered(lambda m: m.picking_id == picking)\n            else:\n                moves_to_backorder = picking._get_moves_to_backorder()\n            moves_to_backorder._recompute_state()\n            if moves_to_backorder:\n                backorder_picking = picking._create_backorder_picking()\n                moves_to_backorder.write({'picking_id': backorder_picking.id, 'picked': False})\n                moves_to_backorder.move_line_ids.package_level_id.write({'picking_id': backorder_picking.id})\n                moves_to_backorder.mapped('move_line_ids').write({'picking_id': backorder_picking.id})\n                backorders |= backorder_picking\n                backorder_picking.user_id = False\n                picking.message_post(\n                    body=_('The backorder %s has been created.', backorder_picking._get_html_link())\n                )\n                if backorder_picking.picking_type_id.reservation_method == 'at_confirm':\n                    bo_to_assign |= backorder_picking\n        if bo_to_assign:\n            bo_to_assign.action_assign()\n        return backorders\n\n    def _log_activity_get_documents(self, orig_obj_changes, stream_field, stream, groupby_method=False):\n        \"\"\" Generic method to log activity. To use with\n        _log_activity method. It either log on uppermost\n        ongoing documents or following documents. This method\n        find all the documents and responsible for which a note\n        has to be log. It also generate a rendering_context in\n        order to render a specific note by documents containing\n        only the information relative to the document it. For example\n        we don't want to notify a picking on move that it doesn't\n        contain.\n\n        :param orig_obj_changes dict: contain a record as key and the\n        change on this record as value.\n        eg: {'move_id': (new product_uom_qty, old product_uom_qty)}\n        :param stream_field string: It has to be a field of the\n        records that are register in the key of 'orig_obj_changes'\n        eg: 'move_dest_ids' if we use move as record (previous example)\n            - 'UP' if we want to log on the upper most ongoing\n            documents.\n            - 'DOWN' if we want to log on following documents.\n        :param groupby_method: Only need when\n        stream is 'DOWN', it should group by tuple(object on\n        which the activity is log, the responsible for this object)\n        \"\"\"\n        if self.env.context.get('skip_activity'):\n            return {}\n        move_to_orig_object_rel = {co: ooc for ooc in orig_obj_changes.keys() for co in ooc[stream_field]}\n        origin_objects = self.env[list(orig_obj_changes.keys())[0]._name].concat(*list(orig_obj_changes.keys()))\n        # The purpose here is to group each destination object by\n        # (document to log, responsible) no matter the stream direction.\n        # example:\n        # {'(delivery_picking_1, admin)': stock.move(1, 2)\n        #  '(delivery_picking_2, admin)': stock.move(3)}\n        visited_documents = {}\n        if stream == 'DOWN':\n            if groupby_method:\n                grouped_moves = groupby(origin_objects.mapped(stream_field), key=groupby_method)\n            else:\n                raise AssertionError('You have to define a groupby method and pass them as arguments.')\n        elif stream == 'UP':\n            # When using upstream document it is required to define\n            # _get_upstream_documents_and_responsibles on\n            # destination objects in order to ascend documents.\n            grouped_moves = {}\n            for visited_move in origin_objects.mapped(stream_field):\n                for document, responsible, visited in visited_move._get_upstream_documents_and_responsibles(self.env[visited_move._name]):\n                    if grouped_moves.get((document, responsible)):\n                        grouped_moves[(document, responsible)] |= visited_move\n                        visited_documents[(document, responsible)] |= visited\n                    else:\n                        grouped_moves[(document, responsible)] = visited_move\n                        visited_documents[(document, responsible)] = visited\n            grouped_moves = grouped_moves.items()\n        else:\n            raise AssertionError('Unknown stream.')\n\n        documents = {}\n        for (parent, responsible), moves in grouped_moves:\n            if not parent:\n                continue\n            moves = self.env[moves[0]._name].concat(*moves)\n            # Get the note\n            rendering_context = {move: (orig_object, orig_obj_changes[orig_object]) for move in moves for orig_object in move_to_orig_object_rel[move]}\n            if visited_documents:\n                documents[(parent, responsible)] = rendering_context, visited_documents.values()\n            else:\n                documents[(parent, responsible)] = rendering_context\n        return documents\n\n    def _log_activity(self, render_method, documents):\n        \"\"\" Log a note for each documents, responsible pair in\n        documents passed as argument. The render_method is then\n        call in order to use a template and render it with a\n        rendering_context.\n\n        :param documents dict: A tuple (document, responsible) as key.\n        An activity will be log by key. A rendering_context as value.\n        If used with _log_activity_get_documents. In 'DOWN' stream\n        cases the rendering_context will be a dict with format:\n        {'stream_object': ('orig_object', new_qty, old_qty)}\n        'UP' stream will add all the documents browsed in order to\n        get the final/upstream document present in the key.\n        :param render_method method: a static function that will generate\n        the html note to log on the activity. The render_method should\n        use the args:\n            - rendering_context dict: value of the documents argument\n        the render_method should return a string with an html format\n        :param stream string:\n        \"\"\"\n        for (parent, responsible), rendering_context in documents.items():\n            note = render_method(rendering_context)\n            parent.sudo().activity_schedule(\n                'mail.mail_activity_data_warning',\n                date.today(),\n                note=note,\n                user_id=responsible.id or SUPERUSER_ID\n            )\n\n    def _log_less_quantities_than_expected(self, moves):\n        \"\"\" Log an activity on picking that follow moves. The note\n        contains the moves changes and all the impacted picking.\n\n        :param dict moves: a dict with a move as key and tuple with\n        new and old quantity as value. eg: {move_1 : (4, 5)}\n        \"\"\"\n        def _keys_in_groupby(move):\n            \"\"\" group by picking and the responsible for the product the\n            move.\n            \"\"\"\n            return (move.picking_id, move.product_id.responsible_id)\n\n        def _render_note_exception_quantity(rendering_context):\n            \"\"\" :param rendering_context:\n            {'move_dest': (move_orig, (new_qty, old_qty))}\n            \"\"\"\n            origin_moves = self.env['stock.move'].browse([move.id for move_orig in rendering_context.values() for move in move_orig[0]])\n            origin_picking = origin_moves.mapped('picking_id')\n            move_dest_ids = self.env['stock.move'].concat(*rendering_context.keys())\n            impacted_pickings = origin_picking._get_impacted_pickings(move_dest_ids) - move_dest_ids.mapped('picking_id')\n            values = {\n                'origin_picking': origin_picking,\n                'moves_information': rendering_context.values(),\n                'impacted_pickings': impacted_pickings,\n            }\n            return self.env['ir.qweb']._render('stock.exception_on_picking', values)\n\n        documents = self._log_activity_get_documents(moves, 'move_dest_ids', 'DOWN', _keys_in_groupby)\n        documents = self._less_quantities_than_expected_add_documents(moves, documents)\n        self._log_activity(_render_note_exception_quantity, documents)\n\n    def _less_quantities_than_expected_add_documents(self, moves, documents):\n        return documents\n\n    def _get_impacted_pickings(self, moves):\n        \"\"\" This function is used in _log_less_quantities_than_expected\n        the purpose is to notify a user with all the pickings that are\n        impacted by an action on a chained move.\n        param: 'moves' contain moves that belong to a common picking.\n        return: all the pickings that contain a destination moves\n        (direct and indirect) from the moves given as arguments.\n        \"\"\"\n\n        def _explore(impacted_pickings, explored_moves, moves_to_explore):\n            for move in moves_to_explore:\n                if move not in explored_moves:\n                    impacted_pickings |= move.picking_id\n                    explored_moves |= move\n                    moves_to_explore |= move.move_dest_ids\n            moves_to_explore = moves_to_explore - explored_moves\n            if moves_to_explore:\n                return _explore(impacted_pickings, explored_moves, moves_to_explore)\n            else:\n                return impacted_pickings\n\n        return _explore(self.env['stock.picking'], self.env['stock.move'], moves)\n\n    def _pre_put_in_pack_hook(self, move_line_ids):\n        return self._check_destinations(move_line_ids)\n\n    def _check_destinations(self, move_line_ids):\n        if len(move_line_ids.mapped('location_dest_id')) > 1:\n            view_id = self.env.ref('stock.stock_package_destination_form_view').id\n            wiz = self.env['stock.package.destination'].create({\n                'picking_id': self.id,\n                'location_dest_id': move_line_ids[0].location_dest_id.id,\n            })\n            return {\n                'name': _('Choose destination location'),\n                'view_mode': 'form',\n                'res_model': 'stock.package.destination',\n                'view_id': view_id,\n                'views': [(view_id, 'form')],\n                'type': 'ir.actions.act_window',\n                'res_id': wiz.id,\n                'target': 'new',\n                'context': {\n                    'move_lines_to_pack_ids': move_line_ids.ids,\n                }\n            }\n        else:\n            return {}\n\n    def _put_in_pack(self, move_line_ids):\n        package = self._get_put_in_pack_package()\n        package_type = move_line_ids.move_id.product_packaging_id.package_type_id\n        if len(package_type) == 1:\n            package.package_type_id = package_type\n        if len(move_line_ids) == 1:\n            default_dest_location = move_line_ids._get_default_dest_location()\n            move_line_ids.location_dest_id = default_dest_location._get_putaway_strategy(\n                product=move_line_ids.product_id,\n                quantity=move_line_ids.quantity,\n                package=package)\n        move_line_ids.write({\n            'result_package_id': package.id,\n        })\n        if len(self) == 1:\n            self.env['stock.package_level'].with_context(from_put_in_pack=True).create({\n                'package_id': package.id,\n                'picking_id': self.id,\n                'location_id': False,\n                'location_dest_id': move_line_ids.location_dest_id.id,\n                'move_line_ids': [(6, 0, move_line_ids.ids)],\n                'company_id': self.company_id.id,\n            })\n        return package\n\n    def _get_put_in_pack_package(self):\n        return self.env['stock.quant.package'].create({})\n\n    def _post_put_in_pack_hook(self, package_id):\n        if package_id and self.picking_type_id.auto_print_package_label:\n            if self.picking_type_id.package_label_to_print == 'pdf':\n                action = self.env.ref(\"stock.action_report_quant_package_barcode_small\").report_action(package_id.id, config=False)\n            elif self.picking_type_id.package_label_to_print == 'zpl':\n                action = self.env.ref(\"stock.label_package_template\").report_action(package_id.id, config=False)\n            if action:\n                action.update({'close_on_report_download': True})\n                clean_action(action, self.env)\n                return action\n        return package_id\n\n    def _package_move_lines(self, batch_pack=False, move_lines_to_pack=False):\n        # in theory, the picking_type should always be the same (i.e. for batch transfers),\n        # but customizations may bypass it and cause unexpected behavior so we avoid allowing those situations\n        if len(self.picking_type_id) > 1:\n            raise UserError(_(\"You cannot pack products into the same package when they are from different transfers with different operation types.\"))\n        quantity_move_line_ids = self.move_line_ids.filtered(\n            lambda ml:\n                float_compare(ml.quantity, 0.0, precision_rounding=ml.product_uom_id.rounding) > 0 and\n                not ml.result_package_id\n        )\n        move_line_ids = quantity_move_line_ids.filtered(lambda ml: ml.picked)\n        if not move_line_ids:\n            move_line_ids = quantity_move_line_ids\n        if move_lines_to_pack:\n            move_line_ids = move_line_ids & move_lines_to_pack\n        return move_line_ids\n\n    def action_put_in_pack(self, move_lines_to_pack=False):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        if self.env.context.get('sml_specific_default'):\n            self = self.with_context(clean_context(self.env.context))\n        if self.state not in ('done', 'cancel'):\n            move_line_ids = self._package_move_lines(move_lines_to_pack=move_lines_to_pack)\n            if move_line_ids:\n                res = self._pre_put_in_pack_hook(move_line_ids)\n                if not res:\n                    package = self._put_in_pack(move_line_ids)\n                    return self._post_put_in_pack_hook(package)\n                return res\n            raise UserError(_(\"There is nothing eligible to put in a pack. Either there are no quantities to put in a pack or all products are already in a pack.\"))\n\n    @api.model\n    def get_action_click_graph(self):\n        return self._get_action(\"stock.action_picking_tree_graph\")\n\n    def _get_action(self, action_xmlid):\n        action = self.env[\"ir.actions.actions\"]._for_xml_id(action_xmlid)\n        context = self.env.context\n        context.update(literal_eval(action['context']))\n        action['context'] = context\n\n        action['help'] = self.env['ir.ui.view']._render_template(\n            'stock.help_message_template', {\n                'picking_type_code': context.get('restricted_picking_type_code') or self.picking_type_code,\n            }\n        )\n\n        return action\n\n    @api.model\n    def get_action_picking_tree_incoming(self):\n        return self._get_action('stock.action_picking_tree_incoming')\n\n    @api.model\n    def get_action_picking_tree_outgoing(self):\n        return self._get_action('stock.action_picking_tree_outgoing')\n\n    @api.model\n    def get_action_picking_tree_internal(self):\n        return self._get_action('stock.action_picking_tree_internal')\n\n    @api.model\n    def calculate_date_category(self, datetime):\n        \"\"\"\n        Assigns given datetime to one of the following categories:\n        - \"before\"\n        - \"yesterday\"\n        - \"today\"\n        - \"day_1\" (tomorrow)\n        - \"day_2\" (the day after tomorrow)\n        - \"after\"\n\n        The categories are based on current user's timezone (e.g. \"today\" will last\n        between 00:00 and 23:59 local time). The datetime itself is assumed to be\n        in UTC. If the datetime is falsy, this function returns \"\".\n        \"\"\"\n        start_today = fields.Datetime.context_timestamp(\n            self.env.user, fields.Datetime.now()\n        ).replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)\n\n        start_yesterday = start_today + timedelta(days=-1)\n        start_day_1 = start_today + timedelta(days=1)\n        start_day_2 = start_today + timedelta(days=2)\n        start_day_3 = start_today + timedelta(days=3)\n\n        date_category = \"\"\n\n        if datetime:\n            datetime = datetime.astimezone(pytz.UTC)\n            if datetime < start_yesterday:\n                date_category = \"before\"\n            elif datetime >= start_yesterday and datetime < start_today:\n                date_category = \"yesterday\"\n            elif datetime >= start_today and datetime < start_day_1:\n                date_category = \"today\"\n            elif datetime >= start_day_1 and datetime < start_day_2:\n                date_category = \"day_1\"\n            elif datetime >= start_day_2 and datetime < start_day_3:\n                date_category = \"day_2\"\n            else:\n                date_category = \"after\"\n\n        return date_category\n\n    @api.model\n    def date_category_to_domain(self, date_category):\n        \"\"\"\n        Given a date category, returns a list of tuples of operator and value\n        that can be used in a domain to filter records based on their scheduled date.\n\n        Args:\n            date_category (str): The date category to use for the computation.\n                Allowed values are:\n                * \"before\"\n                * \"yesterday\"\n                * \"today\"\n                * \"day_1\"\n                * \"day_2\"\n                * \"after\"\n\n        Returns:\n            a list of tuples:\n                each tuple consists of an operator and a value that can be used in\n                a domain to filter records based on their scheduled date.\n                The operator can be \"<\" or \">=\". The value is a datetime object.\n                If an incorrect date category is passed, this method returns None.\n        \"\"\"\n        start_today = fields.Datetime.context_timestamp(\n            self.env.user, fields.Datetime.now()\n        ).replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)\n\n        start_today = start_today.astimezone(pytz.UTC)\n\n        start_yesterday = start_today + timedelta(days=-1)\n        start_day_1 = start_today + timedelta(days=1)\n        start_day_2 = start_today + timedelta(days=2)\n        start_day_3 = start_today + timedelta(days=3)\n\n        date_category_to_search_domain = {\n            \"before\": [(\"<\", start_yesterday)],\n            \"yesterday\": [(\">=\", start_yesterday), (\"<\", start_today)],\n            \"today\": [(\">=\", start_today), (\"<\", start_day_1)],\n            \"day_1\": [(\">=\", start_day_1), (\"<\", start_day_2)],\n            \"day_2\": [(\">=\", start_day_2), (\"<\", start_day_3)],\n            \"after\": [(\">=\", start_day_3)],\n        }\n\n        return date_category_to_search_domain.get(date_category)\n\n    def button_scrap(self):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        view = self.env.ref('stock.stock_scrap_form_view2')\n        products = self.env['product.product']\n        for move in self.move_ids:\n            if move.state not in ('draft', 'cancel') and move.product_id.type == 'consu':\n                products |= move.product_id\n        return {\n            'name': _('Scrap Products'),\n            'view_mode': 'form',\n            'res_model': 'stock.scrap',\n            'view_id': view.id,\n            'views': [(view.id, 'form')],\n            'type': 'ir.actions.act_window',\n            'context': {'default_picking_id': self.id, 'product_ids': products.ids, 'default_company_id': self.company_id.id},\n            'target': 'new',\n        }\n\n    def action_see_move_scrap(self):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        action = self.env[\"ir.actions.actions\"]._for_xml_id(\"stock.action_stock_scrap\")\n        scraps = self.env['stock.scrap'].search([('picking_id', '=', self.id)])\n        action['domain'] = [('id', 'in', scraps.ids)]\n        action['context'] = dict(self._context, create=False)\n        return action\n\n    def action_see_packages(self):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        action = self.env[\"ir.actions.actions\"]._for_xml_id(\"stock.action_package_view\")\n        packages = self.move_line_ids.mapped('result_package_id')\n        action['domain'] = [('id', 'in', packages.ids)]\n        action['context'] = {'picking_id': self.id}\n        return action\n\n    def action_picking_move_tree(self):\n        action = self.env[\"ir.actions.actions\"]._for_xml_id(\"stock.stock_move_action\")\n        action['views'] = [\n            (self.env.ref('stock.view_picking_move_tree').id, 'list'),\n        ]\n        action['context'] = self.env.context\n        action['domain'] = [('picking_id', 'in', self.ids)]\n        return action\n\n    def action_view_reception_report(self):\n        return self.env[\"ir.actions.actions\"]._for_xml_id(\"stock.stock_reception_action\")\n\n    def action_open_label_layout(self):\n        view = self.env.ref('stock.product_label_layout_form_picking')\n        return {\n            'name': _('Choose Labels Layout'),\n            'type': 'ir.actions.act_window',\n            'res_model': 'product.label.layout',\n            'views': [(view.id, 'form')],\n            'target': 'new',\n            'context': {\n                'default_product_ids': self.move_ids.product_id.ids,\n                'default_move_ids': self.move_ids.ids,\n                'default_move_quantity': 'move'},\n        }\n\n    def action_open_label_type(self):\n        if self.env.user.has_group('stock.group_production_lot') and self.move_line_ids.lot_id:\n            view = self.env.ref('stock.picking_label_type_form')\n            return {\n                'name': _('Choose Type of Labels To Print'),\n                'type': 'ir.actions.act_window',\n                'res_model': 'picking.label.type',\n                'views': [(view.id, 'form')],\n                'target': 'new',\n                'context': {'default_picking_ids': self.ids},\n            }\n        return self.action_open_label_layout()\n\n    def _attach_sign(self):\n        \"\"\" Render the delivery report in pdf and attach it to the picking in `self`. \"\"\"\n        self.ensure_one()\n        report = self.env['ir.actions.report']._render_qweb_pdf(\"stock.action_report_delivery\", self.id)\n        filename = \"%s_signed_delivery_slip\" % self.name\n        if self.partner_id:\n            message = _('Order signed by %s', self.partner_id.name)\n        else:\n            message = _('Order signed')\n        self.message_post(\n            attachments=[('%s.pdf' % filename, report[0])],\n            body=message,\n        )\n        return True\n\n    def action_see_returns(self):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        if len(self.return_ids) == 1:\n            return {\n                \"type\": \"ir.actions.act_window\",\n                \"res_model\": \"stock.picking\",\n                \"views\": [[False, \"form\"]],\n                \"res_id\": self.return_ids.id\n            }\n        return {\n            'name': _('Returns'),\n            \"type\": \"ir.actions.act_window\",\n            \"res_model\": \"stock.picking\",\n            \"views\": [[False, \"list\"], [False, \"form\"]],\n            \"domain\": [('id', 'in', self.return_ids.ids)],\n        }\n\n    def _get_report_lang(self):\n        return self.move_ids and self.move_ids[0].partner_id.lang or self.partner_id.lang or self.env.lang\n\n    def _get_autoprint_report_actions(self):\n        report_actions = []\n        pickings_to_print = self.filtered(lambda p: p.picking_type_id.auto_print_delivery_slip)\n        if pickings_to_print:\n            action = self.env.ref(\"stock.action_report_delivery\").report_action(pickings_to_print.ids, config=False)\n            clean_action(action, self.env)\n            report_actions.append(action)\n        pickings_print_return_slip = self.filtered(lambda p: p.picking_type_id.auto_print_return_slip)\n        if pickings_print_return_slip:\n            action = self.env.ref(\"stock.return_label_report\").report_action(pickings_print_return_slip.ids, config=False)\n            clean_action(action, self.env)\n            report_actions.append(action)\n\n        if self.env.user.has_group('stock.group_reception_report'):\n            reception_reports_to_print = self.filtered(\n                lambda p: p.picking_type_id.auto_print_reception_report\n                          and p.picking_type_id.code != 'outgoing'\n                          and p.move_ids.move_dest_ids\n            )\n            if reception_reports_to_print:\n                action = self.env.ref('stock.stock_reception_report_action').report_action(reception_reports_to_print, config=False)\n                clean_action(action, self.env)\n                report_actions.append(action)\n            reception_labels_to_print = self.filtered(lambda p: p.picking_type_id.auto_print_reception_report_labels and p.picking_type_id.code != 'outgoing')\n            if reception_labels_to_print:\n                moves_to_print = reception_labels_to_print.move_ids.move_dest_ids\n                if moves_to_print:\n                    # needs to be string to support python + js calls to report\n                    quantities = ','.join(str(qty) for qty in moves_to_print.mapped(lambda m: Allow user managing payments without any statement lines by using the bank account directly.\n                    # In that case, the user manages transactions only using the register payment wizard.\n                    pay.is_matched = True\n                else:\n                    pay.is_matched = pay.currency_id.is_zero(sum(liquidity_lines.mapped(residual_field)))\n\n                reconcile_lines = (counterpart_lines + writeoff_lines).filtered(lambda line: line.account_id.reconcile)\n                pay.is_reconciled = pay.currency_id.is_zero(sum(reconcile_lines.mapped(residual_field)))\n\n    @api.model\n    def _get_method_codes_using_bank_account(self):\n        return ['manual']\n\n    @api.model\n    def _get_method_codes_needing_bank_account(self):\n        return []\n\n    def action_open_business_doc(self):\n        return {\n            'name': _(\"Payment\"),\n            'type': 'ir.actions.act_window',\n            'views': [(False, 'form')],\n            'res_model': 'account.payment',\n            'res_id': self.id,\n        }\n\n    @api.depends('payment_method_code')\n    def _compute_show_require_partner_bank(self):\n        \"\"\" Computes if the destination bank account must be displayed in the payment form view. By default, it\n        won't be displayed but some modules might change that, depending on the payment type.\"\"\"\n        for payment in self:\n            if payment.journal_id.type == 'cash':\n                payment.show_partner_bank_account = False\n            else:\n                payment.show_partner_bank_account = payment.payment_method_code in self._get_method_codes_using_bank_account()\n            payment.require_partner_bank_account = payment.state == 'draft' and payment.payment_method_code in self._get_method_codes_needing_bank_account()\n\n    @api.depends('move_id.amount_total_signed', 'amount', 'payment_type', 'currency_id', 'date', 'company_id', 'company_currency_id')\n    def _compute_amount_company_currency_signed(self):\n        for payment in self:\n            if payment.move_id:\n                liquidity_lines = payment._seek_for_lines()[0]\n                payment.amount_company_currency_signed = sum(liquidity_lines.mapped('balance'))\n            else:\n                payment.amount_company_currency_signed = payment.currency_id._convert(\n                    from_amount=payment.amount_signed,\n                    to_currency=payment.company_currency_id,\n                    company=payment.company_id,\n                    date=payment.date,\n                )\n\n    @api.depends('amount', 'payment_type')\n    def _compute_amount_signed(self):\n        for payment in self:\n            if payment.payment_type == 'outbound':\n                payment.amount_signed = -payment.amount\n            else:\n                payment.amount_signed = payment.amount\n\n    @api.depends('partner_id', 'company_id', 'payment_type')\n    def _compute_available_partner_bank_ids(self):\n        for pay in self:\n            if pay.payment_type == 'inbound':\n                pay.available_partner_bank_ids = pay.journal_id.bank_account_id\n            else:\n                pay.available_partner_bank_ids = pay.partner_id.bank_ids\\\n                        .filtered(lambda x: x.company_id.id in (False, pay.company_id.id))._origin\n\n    @api.depends('available_partner_bank_ids', 'journal_id')\n    def _compute_partner_bank_id(self):\n        ''' The default partner_bank_id will be the first available on the partner. '''\n        for pay in self:\n            if pay.partner_bank_id not in pay.available_partner_bank_ids:\n                pay.partner_bank_id = pay.available_partner_bank_ids[:1]._origin\n\n    @api.depends('available_payment_method_line_ids')\n    def _compute_payment_method_line_id(self):\n        ''' Compute the 'payment_method_line_id' field.\n        This field is not computed in '_compute_payment_method_line_fields' because it's a stored editable one.\n        '''\n        for pay in self:\n            available_payment_method_lines = pay.available_payment_method_line_ids\n            inbound_payment_method = pay.partner_id.property_inbound_payment_method_line_id\n            outbound_payment_method = pay.partner_id.property_outbound_payment_method_line_id\n            if pay.payment_type == 'inbound' and inbound_payment_method.id in available_payment_method_lines.ids:\n                pay.payment_method_line_id = inbound_payment_method\n            elif pay.payment_type == 'outbound' and outbound_payment_method.id in available_payment_method_lines.ids:\n                pay.payment_method_line_id = outbound_payment_method\n            elif pay.payment_method_line_id.id in available_payment_method_lines.ids:\n                pay.payment_method_line_id = pay.payment_method_line_id\n            elif available_payment_method_lines:\n                pay.payment_method_line_id = available_payment_method_lines[0]._origin\n            else:\n                pay.payment_method_line_id = False\n\n    @api.depends('payment_type', 'journal_id', 'currency_id')\n    def _compute_payment_method_line_fields(self):\n        for pay in self:\n            pay.available_payment_method_line_ids = pay.journal_id._get_available_payment_method_lines(pay.payment_type)\n            to_exclude = pay._get_payment_method_codes_to_exclude()\n            if to_exclude:\n                pay.available_payment_method_line_ids = pay.available_payment_method_line_ids.filtered(lambda x: x.code not in to_exclude)\n\n    @api.depends('payment_type')\n    def _compute_available_journal_ids(self):\n        \"\"\"\n        Get all journals having at least one payment method for inbound/outbound depending on the payment_type.\n        \"\"\"\n        journals = self.env['account.journal'].search([\n            '|',\n            ('company_id', 'parent_of', self.env.company.id),\n            ('company_id', 'child_of', self.env.company.id),\n            ('type', 'in', ('bank', 'cash', 'credit')),\n        ])\n        for pay in self:\n            if pay.payment_type == 'inbound':\n                pay.available_journal_ids = journals.filtered('inbound_payment_method_line_ids')\n            else:\n                pay.available_journal_ids = journals.filtered('outbound_payment_method_line_ids')\n\n    def @api.depends('journal_id')\n    def _compute_currency_id(self):\n        for pay in self:\n            pay.currency_id = pay.journal_id.currency_id or pay.journal_id.company_id.currency_id\n\n    def _compute_partner_id(self):\n        pass\n\n    @api.depends('payment_method_line_id')\n    def _compute_outstanding_account_id(self):\n        for pay in self:\n            pay.outstanding_account_id = pay.payment_method_line_id.payment_account_id\n\n    @api.depends('journal_id', 'partner_id', 'partner_type')\n    def _compute_destination_account_id(self):\n        self.destination_account_id = False\n        for pay in self:\n            if pay.partner_type == 'customer':\n                # Receive money from invoice or send money to refund it.\n                if pay.partner_id:\n                    pay.destination_account_id = pay.partner_id.with_company(pay.company_id).property_account_receivable_id\n                else:\n                    pay.destination_account_id = self.env['account.account'].with_company(pay.company_id).search([\n                        *self.env['account.account']._check_company_domain(pay.company_id),\n                        ('account_type', '=', 'asset_receivable'),\n                        ('deprecated', '=', False),\n                    ], limit=1)\n            elif pay.partner_type == 'supplier':\n                # Send money to pay a bill or receive money to refund it.\n                if pay.partner_id:\n                    pay.destination_account_id = pay.partner_id.with_company(pay.company_id).property_account_payable_id\n                else:\n                    pay.destination_account_id = self.env['account.account'].with_company(pay.company_id).search([\n                        *self.env['account.account']._check_company_domain(pay.company_id),\n                        ('account_type', '=', 'liability_payable'),\n                        ('deprecated', '=', False),\n                    ], limit=1)\n\n    @api.depends('partner_bank_id', 'amount', 'memo', 'currency_id', 'journal_id', 'move_id.state',\n                 'payment_method_line_id', 'payment_type')\n    def _compute_qr_code(self):\n        for pay in self:\n            if pay.state in ('draft', 'in_process') \\\n                and pay.partner_bank_id \\\n                and pay.partner_bank_id.allow_out_payment \\\n                and pay.payment_method_line_id.code == 'manual' \\\n                and pay.payment_type == 'outbound' \\\n                and pay.currency_id:\n\n                if pay.partner_bank_id:\n                    qr_code = pay.partner_bank_id.build_qr_code_base64(pay.amount, pay.memo, pay.memo, pay.currency_id, pay.partner_id)\n                else:\n                    qr_code = None\n\n                if qr_code:\n                    pay.qr_code = '''\n                        <br/>\n                        <img class=\"border border-dark rounded\" src=\"{qr_code}\"/>\n                        <br/>\n                        <strong class=\"text-center\">{txt}</strong>\n                        '''.format(txt = _('Scan me with your banking app.'),\n                                   qr_code = qr_code)\n                    continue\n\n            pay.qr_code = None\n\n    @api.depends('move_id.line_ids.matched_debit_ids', 'move_id.line_ids.matched_credit_ids', 'invoice_ids')\n    def _compute_stat_buttons_from_reconciliation(self):\n        ''' Retrieve the invoices reconciled to the payments through the reconciliation (account.partial.reconcile). '''\n        stored_payments = self.filtered('id')\n        if not stored_payments:\n            self.reconciled_invoice_ids = False\n            self.reconciled_invoices_count = 0\n            self.reconciled_invoices_type = False\n            self.reconciled_bill_ids = False\n            self.reconciled_bills_count = 0\n            self.reconciled_statement_line_ids = False\n            self.reconciled_statement_lines_count = 0\n            return\n\n        self.env['account.payment'].flush_model(fnames=['move_id', 'outstanding_account_id'])\n        self.env['account.move'].flush_model(fnames=['move_type', 'origin_payment_id', 'statement_line_id'])\n        self.env['account.move.line'].flush_model(fnames=['move_id', 'account_id', 'statement_line_id'])\n        self.env['account.partial.reconcile'].flush_model(fnames=['debit_move_id', 'credit_move_id'])\n\n        self._cr.execute('''\n            SELECT\n                payment.id,\n                ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT invoice.id) AS invoice_ids,\n                invoice.move_type\n            FROM account_payment payment\n            JOIN account_move move ON move.id = payment.move_id\n            JOIN account_move_line line ON line.move_id = move.id\n            JOIN account_partial_reconcile part ON\n                part.debit_move_id = line.id\n                OR\n                part.credit_move_id = line.id\n            JOIN account_move_line counterpart_line ON\n                part.debit_move_id = counterpart_line.id\n                OR\n                part.credit_move_id = counterpart_line.id\n            JOIN account_move invoice ON invoice.id = counterpart_line.move_id\n            JOIN account_account account ON account.id = line.account_id\n            WHERE account.account_type IN ('asset_receivable', 'liability_payable')\n                AND payment.id IN %(payment_ids)s\n                AND line.id != counterpart_line.id\n                AND invoice.move_type in ('out_invoice', 'out_refund', 'in_invoice', 'in_refund', 'out_receipt', 'in_receipt')\n            GROUP BY payment.id, invoice.move_type\n        ''', {\n            'payment_ids': tuple(stored_payments.ids)\n        })\n        query_res = self._cr.dictfetchall()\n\n        for pay in self:\n            pay.reconciled_invoice_ids = pay.invoice_ids.filtered(lambda m: m.is_sale_document(True))\n            pay.reconciled_bill_ids = pay.invoice_ids.filtered(lambda m: m.is_purchase_document(True))\n\n        for res in query_res:\n            pay = self.browse(res['id'])\n            if res['move_type'] in self.env['account.move'].get_sale_types(True):\n                pay.reconciled_invoice_ids |= self.env['account.move'].browse(res.get('invoice_ids', []))\n            else:\n                pay.reconciled_bill_ids |= self.env['account.move'].browse(res.get('invoice_ids', []))\n\n        for pay in self:\n            pay.reconciled_invoices_count = len(pay.reconciled_invoice_ids)\n            pay.reconciled_bills_count = len(pay.reconciled_bill_ids)\n\n        self._cr.execute('''\n            SELECT\n                payment.id,\n                ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT counterpart_line.statement_line_id) AS statement_line_ids\n            FROM account_payment payment\n            JOIN account_move move ON move.id = payment.move_id\n            JOIN account_move_line line ON line.move_id = move.id\n            JOIN account_account account ON account.id = line.account_id\n            JOIN account_partial_reconcile part ON\n                part.debit_move_id = line.id\n                OR\n                part.credit_move_id = line.id\n            JOIN account_move_line counterpart_line ON\n                part.debit_move_id = counterpart_line.id\n                OR\n                part.credit_move_id = counterpart_line.id\n            WHERE account.id = payment.outstanding_account_id\n                AND payment.id IN %(payment_ids)s\n                AND line.id != counterpart_line.id\n                AND counterpart_line.statement_line_id IS NOT NULL\n            GROUP BY payment.id\n        ''', {\n            'payment_ids': tuple(stored_payments.ids)\n        })\n        query_res = dict((payment_id, statement_line_ids) for payment_id, statement_line_ids in self._cr.fetchall())\n\n        for pay in self:\n            statement_line_ids = query_res.get(pay.id, [])\n            pay.reconciled_statement_line_ids = [Command.set(statement_line_ids)]\n            pay.reconciled_statement_lines_count = len(statement_line_ids)\n            if len(pay.reconciled_invoice_ids.mapped('move_type')) == 1 and pay.reconciled_invoice_ids[0].move_type == 'out_refund':\n                pay.reconciled_invoices_type = 'credit_note'\n            else:\n                pay.reconciled_invoices_type = 'invoice'\n\n    def _compute_payment_receipt_title(self):\n        \"\"\" To override in order to change the title displayed on the payment receipt report \"\"\"\n        self.payment_receipt_title = _('Payment Receipt')\n\n    @api.depends('partner_id', 'amount', 'date', 'payment_type')\n    def _compute_duplicate_payment_ids(self):\n        \"\"\" Retrieve move ids with same partner_id, amount and date as the current payment \"\"\"\n        payment_to_duplicate_move = self._fetch_duplicate_reference()\n        for payment in self:\n            # Uses payment._origin.id to handle records in edition/existing records and 0 for new records\n            payment.duplicate_payment_ids = payment_to_duplicate_move.get(payment._origin.id, self.env['account.payment'])\n\n    def _search_reconciled_invoice_ids(self, operator, value):\n        if operator not in ('in', '='):\n            return NotImplemented\n        move_ids = self.env['account.move'].browse(value).reconciled_payment_ids.ids\n        return [('id', 'in', move_ids)]\n\n    def _fetch_duplicate_reference(self, matching_states=('draft', 'in_process')):\n        \"\"\" Retrieve move ids for possible duplicates of payments. Duplicates moves:\n        - Have the same partner_id, amount and date as the payment\n        - Are not reconciled\n        - Represent a credit in the same account receivable or a debit in the same account payable as the payment, or\n        - Represent a credit in outstanding receipts or debit in outstanding payments, so bank statement lines with an\n         outstanding counterpart can be matched, or\n        - Are in the suspense account\n        \"\"\"\n        # Does not perform unnecessary check if partner_id or amount are not set, nor if payment is posted\n        payments = self.filtered(lambda p: p.partner_id and p.amount and p.state != 'in_process')\n        if not payments:\n            return {}\n\n        # Update tables involved in the query\n        used_fields = (\"company_id\", \"partner_id\", \"date\", \"state\", \"amount\", 'payment_type')\n        self.flush_model(used_fields)\n\n        payment_table_and_alias = SQL(\"account_payment AS payment\")\n        if not self[0].id:  # if record is under creation/edition in UI, safely inject values in the query\n            # Necessary since new record aren't searchable in the DB and record in edition aren't up to date yet\n            values = {\n                field_name: self._fields[field_name].convert_to_write(self[field_name], self) or None\n                for field_name in used_fields\n            }\n            values[\"id\"] = self._origin.id or 0\n            # The amount total depends on the field line_ids and is calculated upon saving, we needed a way to get it even when the\n            # invoices has not been saved yet.\n            casted_values = SQL(', ').join(\n                SQL(\"%s::%s\", value, SQL.identifier(self._fields[field_name].column_type[0]))\n                for field_name, value in values.items()\n            )\n            column_names = SQL(', ').join(SQL.identifier(field_name) for field_name in values)\n            payment_table_and_alias = SQL(\"(VALUES (%s)) AS payment(%s)\", casted_values, column_names)\n\n        query = SQL(\n            \"\"\"\n                SELECT payment.id AS payment_id,\n                       ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT duplicate_payment.id) AS duplicate_payment_ids\n                  FROM %(payment_table_and_alias)s\n                  JOIN account_payment AS duplicate_payment ON payment.id != duplicate_payment.id\n                                                           AND payment.partner_id = duplicate_payment.partner_id\n                                                           AND payment.company_id = duplicate_payment.company_id\n                                                           AND payment.date = duplicate_payment.date\n                                                           AND payment.payment_type = duplicate_payment.payment_type\n                                                           AND payment.amount = duplicate_payment.amount\n                                                           AND duplicate_payment.state IN %(matching_states)s\n                 WHERE payment.id = ANY(%(payments)s)\n              GROUP BY payment.id\n            \"\"\",\n            payment_table_and_alias=payment_table_and_alias,\n            matching_states=tuple(matching_states),\n            payments=payments.ids or [0],\n        )\n\n        return {\n            payment_id: self.env['account.payment'].browse(duplicate_ids)\n            for payment_id, duplicate_ids in self.env.execute_query(query)\n        }\n\n    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # ONCHANGE METHODS\n    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    def _inverse_memo(self):\n        for payment in self:\n            move = payment.move_id\n            if move:\n                move.ref = payment.memo\n\n    def _inverse_partner_id(self):\n        # todo: remove in master\n        pass\n\n    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # CONSTRAINT METHODS\n    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    @api.constrains('payment_method_line_id')\n    def _check_payment_method_line_id(self):\n        ''' Ensure the 'payment_method_line_id' field is not null.\n        Can't be done using the regular 'required=True' because the field is a computed editable stored one.\n        '''\n        for pay in self:\n            if not pay.payment_method_line_id:\n                raise ValidationError(_(\"Please define a payment method line on your payment.\"))\n            elif pay.payment_method_line_id.journal_id and pay.payment_method_line_id.journal_id != pay.journal_id:\n                raise ValidationError(_(\"The selected payment method is not available for this payment, please select the payment method again.\"))\n\n    @api.constrains('state', 'move_id')\n    def _check_move_id(self):\n        for payment in self:\n            if (\n                payment.state not in ('draft', 'canceled')\n                and not payment.move_id\n                and payment.outstanding_account_id\n            ):\n                raise ValidationError(_(\"A payment with an outstanding account cannot be confirmed without having a journal entry.\"))\n\n    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # LOW-LEVEL METHODS\n    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    @api.model_create_multi\n    def create(self, vals_list):\n        # OVERRIDE\n        write_off_line_vals_list = []\n        force_balance_vals_list = []\n        linecomplete_line_vals_list = []\n\n        for vals in vals_list:\n\n            # Hack to add a custom write-off line.\n            write_off_line_vals_list.append(vals.pop('write_off_line_vals', None))\n\n            # Hack to force a custom balance.\n            force_balance_vals_list.append(vals.pop('force_balance', None))\n\n            # Hack to add a custom line.\n            linecomplete_line_vals_list.append(vals.pop('line_ids', None))\n\n        payments = super().create(vals_list)\n\n        # Outstanding account should be set on the payment in community edition to force the generation of journal entries on the payment\n        # This is required because no reconciliation is possible in community, which would prevent the user to reconcile the bank statement with the invoice\n        accounting_installed = self.env['account.move']._get_invoice_in_payment_state() == 'in_payment'\n\n        for i, (pay, vals) in enumerate(zip(payments, vals_list)):\n            if not accounting_installed and not pay.outstanding_account_id:\n                outstanding_account = pay._get_outstanding_account(pay.payment_type)\n                pay.outstanding_account_id = outstanding_account.id\n\n            if (\n                write_off_line_vals_list[i] is not None\n                or force_balance_vals_list[i] is not None\n                or linecomplete_line_vals_list[i] is not None\n            ):\n                pay._generate_journal_entry(\n                    write_off_line_vals=write_off_line_vals_list[i],\n                    force_balance=force_balance_vals_list[i],\n                    line_ids=linecomplete_line_vals_list[i],\n                )\n                # propagate the related fields to the move as it is being created after the payment\n                if move_vals := {\n                    fname: value\n                    for fname, value in vals.items()\n                    if self._fields[fname].related and (self._fields[fname].related or '').split('.')[0] == 'move_id'\n                }:\n                    pay.move_id.write(move_vals)\n        return payments\n\n    def _get_outstanding_account(self, payment_type):\n        account_ref = 'account_journal_payment_debit_account_id' if payment_type == 'inbound' else 'account_journal_payment_credit_account_id'\n        chart_template = self.with_context(allowed_company_ids=self.company_id.root_id.ids).env['account.chart.template']\n        outstanding_account = (\n            chart_template.ref(account_ref, raise_if_not_found=False)\n            or self.company_id.transfer_account_id\n        )\n        if not outstanding_account:\n            raise UserError(_(\"No outstanding account could be found to make the payment\"))\n        return outstanding_account\n\n    def write(self, vals):\n        if vals.get('state') in ('in_process', 'paid') and not vals.get('move_id'):\n            self.filtered(lambda p: not p.move_id)._generate_journal_entry()\n            self.move_id.filtered(lambda m: m.state == 'draft').action_post()\n\n        res = super().write(vals)\n        if self.move_id:\n            self._synchronize_to_moves(set(vals.keys()))\n        return res\n\n    def unlink(self):\n        self.move_id.filtered(lambda m: m.state != 'draft').button_draft()\n        self.move_id.unlink()\n\n        linked_invoices = self.reconciled_invoice_ids\n        res = super().unlink()\n        self.env.add_to_compute(linked_invoices._fields['payment_state'], linked_invoices)\n        return res\n\n    @api.depends('move_id.name')\n    def _compute_display_name(self):\n        for payment in self:\n            payment.display_name = payment.name or _('Draft Payment')\n\n    def copy_data(self, default=None):\n        default = dict(default or {})\n        vals_list = super().copy_data(default)\n        for payment, vals in zip(self, vals_list):\n            vals.update({\n                'journal_id': payment.journal_id.id,\n                'payment_method_line_id': payment.payment_method_line_id.id,\n                **(vals or {}),\n            })\n        return vals_list\n\n    def _message_mail_after_hook(self, mails):\n        for payment, mail in zip(self, mails):\n            if (\n                not payment.message_main_attachment_id\n                and (attachments_to_link := mail.attachment_ids.filtered(lambda a: a.res_model == 'mail.message'))\n            ):\n                attachments_to_link.write({'res_model': self._name, 'res_id': payment.id})\n        return super()._message_mail_after_hook(mails)\n\n    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # SYNCHRONIZATION account.payment -> account.move\n    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    def _synchronize_to_moves(self, changed_fields):\n        '''\n            Update the account.move regarding the modified account.payment.\n            :param changed_fields: A list containing all modified fields on account.payment.\n        '''\n        if not any(field_name in changed_fields for field_name in self._get_trigger_fields_to_synchronize()):\n            return\n\n        for pay in self:\n            if pay.move_id.state == 'posted':\n                continue\n            liquidity_lines, counterpart_lines, writeoff_lines = pay._seek_for_lines()\n\n            if 'amount' in changed_fields and len(liquidity_lines) > 1:\n                raise UserError(_(\"You cannot change the amount of a payment with multiple liquidity lines.\"))\n\n            # Make sure to preserve the write-off amount.\n            # This allows to create a new payment with custom 'line_ids'.\n            write_off_line_vals = []\n            if liquidity_lines and counterpart_lines and writeoff_lines:\n                write_off_line_vals.append({\n                    'name': writeoff_lines[0].name,\n                    'account_id': writeoff_lines[0].account_id.id,\n                    'partner_id': writeoff_lines[0].partner_id.id,\n                    'currency_id': writeoff_lines[0].currency_id.id,\n                    'amount_currency': sum(writeoff_lines.mapped('amount_currency')),\n                    'balance': sum(writeoff_lines.mapped('balance')),\n                })\n            line_vals_per_type = pay._prepare_move_lines_per_type(write_off_line_vals=write_off_line_vals)\n            line_ids_commands = []\n\n            liquidity_lines_vals =                   line_ids_commands.append(Command.update(liquidity_line.id, newline_val))\n                elif not liquidity_line and newline_val:\n                    line_ids_commands.append(Command.create(newline_val))\n                elif liquidity_line and not newline_val:\n                    line_ids_commands.append(Command.delete(liquidity_line.id))\n\n line_ids_commands.append((0, 0, extra_line_vals))\n            # Update the existing journal items.\n            # If dealing with multiple write-off lines, they are dropped and a new one is pay.move_id.with_context(skip_invoice_sync=True).write(to_write)\n\n    @api.model\n    def _get_trigger_fields_to_synchronize(self):\n        return (\n            'date', 'amount', 'payment_type', write_off_line_vals and not force_balance and not line_ids)\n\n        move_vals = [\n            pay._generate_move_vals(write_off_line_vals, force_balance, line_ids)\n            for pay in self.ensure_one()\n        return {\n            'move_type': 'entry',\n            'ref': self.memo,\n            'date': self.date,\n            'journal_id': self.journal_id.id,\n self.write({'is_sent': False})\n\n    def action_post(self):\n        ''' draft -> posted '''\n        # Do not allow posting if the account is required but not trusted\n        for payment in self:\n partner=payment.partner_id.display_name,\n                ))\n        self.filtered(lambda pay: pay.outstanding_account_id.account_type == 'asset_cash').state = 'paid'\n        # Avoid going back one self.filtered(lambda pay: pay.state in {False, 'draft', 'in_process'}).state = 'in_process'\n\n    def action_validate(self):\n        self.state = 'paid'\n\n    def action_reject(self):\n        self.state = 'rejected'\n\n    def action_cancel(self):\n        self.state = 'canceled'\n        draft_moves = self.move_id.filtered(lambda m: m.state == 'draft')\n        draft_moves.unlink()\n        (self.move_id - draft_moves).button_cancel()\n\n    def button_request_cancel(self):\n        return self.move_id.button_request_cancel()\n\n    def action_draft(self):\n        self.state = order.pricelist_id = order.partner_id.property_product_pricelist\n\n    @api.depends('pricelist_id', 'company_id')\n    def _compute_currency_id(self):\n        for order in self:\n            order.currency_id = order.pricelist_id.currency_id or order.company_id.currency_id\n\n    @api.depends('currency_id', 'date_order', 'company_id')\n    def _compute_currency_rate(self):\n        for  def _compute_has_active_pricelist(self):\n        for order in self:\n            order.has_active_pricelist = bool(self.env['product.pricelist'].search(\n                [('company_id', 'in', @api.depends('partner_id', 'user_id')\n    def _compute_team_id(self):\n        cached_teams = {}\n        for order in self:\n            default_team_id = self.env.context.get('default_team_id', _get_priced_lines(self):\n        return self.order_line.filtered(lambda x: not x.display_type)\n\n    @api.depends('order_line.price_subtotal', 'currency_id', 'company_id', 'payment_term_id')\n    def _compute_amounts(self):\n        AccountTax = self.env['account.tax']\n        for order in self:\n            order_lines = order._get_priced_lines()\n            base_lines = [line._prepare_base_line_for_taxes_computation() for line in order_lines]\n            base_lines += order._add_base_lines_for_early_payment_discount()\n            AccountTax._add_tax_details_in_base_lines(base_lines, order.company_id)\n            AccountTax._round_base_lines_tax_details(base_lines, order.company_id)\n            tax_totals = AccountTax._get_tax_totals_summary(\n                base_lines=base_lines,\n                currency=order.currency_id or order.company_id.currency_id,\n                company=order.company_id,\n            )\n            order.amount_untaxed = tax_totals['base_amount_currency']\n            order.amount_tax = tax_totals['tax_amount_currency']\n            order.amount_total = tax_totals['total_amount_currency']\n\n    def _add_base_lines_for_early_payment_discount(self):\n        \"\"\"\n        When applying a payment term with an early payment discount, and when said payment term computes the tax on the\n        'mixed' setting, the tax computation is always based on the discounted amount untaxed.\n        Creates the necessary line for this behavior to be displayed.\n        :returns: array containing the necessary lines or empty array if the payment term isn't epd mixed\n        \"\"\"\n        self.ensure_one()\n        epd_lines = []\n        if (\n            self.payment_term_id.early_discount\n            and self.payment_term_id.early_pay_discount_computation == 'mixed'\n            and self.payment_term_id.discount_percentage\n        ):\n            percentage = self.payment_term_id.discount_percentage\n            currency = self.currency_id or self.company_id.currency_id\n            for line in self._get_priced_lines():\n                line_amount_after_discount = (line.price_subtotal / 100) * percentage\n                epd_lines.append(self.env['account.tax']._prepare_base_line_for_taxes_computation(\n                    record=self,\n                    price_unit=-line_amount_after_discount,\n                    quantity=1.0,\n                    currency_id=currency,\n                    sign=1,\n                    special_mode='total_excluded',\n                    special_type='early_payment',\n                    tax_ids=line.tax_id.flatten_taxes_hierarchy().filtered(lambda tax: tax.amount_type != 'fixed'),\n                ))\n                epd_lines.append(self.env['account.tax']._prepare_base_line_for_taxes_computation(\n                    record=self,\n                    price_unit=line_amount_after_discount,\n                    quantity=1.0,\n                    currency_id=currency,\n                    sign=1,\n                    special_mode='total_excluded',\n                    special_type='early_payment',\n                ))\n        return epd_lines\n\n    @api.depends('order_line.invoice_lines')\n    def _get_invoiced(self):\n        # The invoice_ids are obtained thanks to the invoice lines of the SO\n        # lines, and we also search for possible refunds created directly from\n        # existing invoices. This is necessary since such a refund is not\n        # directly linked to the SO.\n        for order in self:\n            invoices = order.order_line.invoice_lines.move_id.filtered(lambda r: r.move_type in ('out_invoice', 'out_refund'))\n            order.invoice_ids = invoices\n            order.invoice_count = len(invoices)\n\n    def _search_invoice_ids(self, operator, value):\n        if operator == 'in' and value:\n            self.env.cr.execute(\"\"\"\n                SELECT array_agg(so.id)\n                    FROM sale_order so\n                    JOIN sale_order_line sol ON sol.order_id = so.id\n                    JOIN sale_order_line_invoice_rel soli_rel ON soli_rel.order_line_id = sol.id\n                    JOIN account_move_line aml ON aml.id = soli_rel.invoice_line_id\n                    JOIN account_move am ON am.id = aml.move_id\n                WHERE\n                    am.move_type in ('out_invoice', 'out_refund') AND\n                    am.id = ANY(%s)\n            \"\"\", (list(value),))\n            so_ids = self.env.cr.fetchone()[0] or []\n            return [('id', 'in', so_ids)]\n        elif operator == '=' and not value:\n            # special case for [('invoice_ids', '=', False)], i.e. \"Invoices is not set\"\n            #\n            # We cannot just search [('order_line.invoice_lines', '=', False)]\n            # because it returns orders with uninvoiced lines, which is not\n            # same \"Invoices is not set\" (some lines may have invoices and some\n            # doesn't)\n            #\n            # A solution is making inverted search first (\"orders with invoiced\n            # lines\") and then invert results (\"get all other orders\")\n            #\n            # Domain below returns subset of ('order_line.invoice_lines', '!=', False)\n            order_ids = self._search([\n                ('order_line.invoice_lines.move_id.move_type', 'in', ('out_invoice', 'out_refund'))\n            ])\n            return [('id', 'not in', order_ids)]\n        return [\n            ('order_line.invoice_lines.move_id.move_type', 'in', ('out_invoice', 'out_refund')),\n            ('order_line.invoice_lines.move_id', operator, value),\n        ]\n\n    @api.depends('state', 'order_line.invoice_status')\n    def _compute_invoice_status(self):\n        \"\"\"\n        Compute the invoice status of a SO. Possible statuses:\n        - no: if the SO is not in status 'sale' or 'done', we consider that there is nothing to\n          invoice. This is also the default value if the conditions of no other status is met.\n        - to invoice: if any SO line is 'to invoice', the whole SO is 'to invoice'\n        - invoiced: if all SO lines are invoiced, the SO is invoiced.\n        - upselling: if all SO lines are invoiced or upselling, the status is upselling.\n        \"\"\"\n        confirmed_orders = self.filtered(lambda so: so.state == 'sale')\n        (self - confirmed_orders).invoice_status = 'no'\n        if not confirmed_orders:\n            return\n        lines_domain = [('is_downpayment', '=', False), ('display_type', '=', False)]\n        line_invoice_status_all = [\n            (order.id, invoice_status)\n            for order, invoice_status in self.env['sale.order.line']._read_group(\n                lines_domain + [('order_id', 'in', confirmed_orders.ids)],\n                ['order_id', 'invoice_status']\n            )\n        ]\n        for order in confirmed_orders:\n            line_invoice_status = [d[1] for d in line_invoice_status_all if d[0] == order.id]\n            if order.state != 'sale':\n                order.invoice_status = 'no'\n            elif any(invoice_status == 'to invoice' for invoice_status in line_invoice_status):\n                if any(invoice_status == 'no' for invoice_status in line_invoice_status):\n                    # If only discount/delivery/promotion lines can be invoiced, the SO should not\n                    # be invoiceable.\n                    invoiceable_domain = lines_domain + [('invoice_status', '=', 'to invoice')]\n                    invoiceable_lines = order.order_line.filtered_domain(invoiceable_domain)\n                    special_lines = invoiceable_lines.filtered(\n                        lambda sol: not sol._can_be_invoiced_alone()\n                    )\n                    if invoiceable_lines == special_lines:\n                        order.invoice_status = 'no'\n                    else:\n                        order.invoice_status = 'to invoice'\n                else:\n                    order.invoice_status = 'to invoice'\n            elif line_invoice_status and all(invoice_status == 'invoiced' for invoice_status in line_invoice_status):\n                order.invoice_status = 'invoiced'\n            elif line_invoice_status and all(invoice_status in ('invoiced', 'upselling') for invoice_status in line_invoice_status):\n                order.invoice_status = 'upselling'\n            else:\n                order.invoice_status = 'no'\n\n    @api.depends('transaction_ids')\n    def _compute_authorized_transaction_ids(self):\n        for trans in self:\n            trans.authorized_transaction_ids = trans.transaction_ids.filtered(lambda t: t.state == 'authorized')\n\n    @api.depends('transaction_ids')\n    def _compute_amount_paid(self):\n        \"\"\" Sum of the amount paid through all transactions for this SO. \"\"\"\n        for order in self:\n            order.amount_paid = sum(\n                tx.amount for tx in order.transaction_ids if tx.state in ('authorized', 'done')\n            )\n\n    def _compute_amount_undiscounted(self):\n        for (line.price_unit * line.product_uom_qty)\n            order.amount_undiscounted = total\n\n    @api.depends('client_order_ref', 'date_order', 'origin', 'partner_id')\n    def [Command.set(order_to_duplicate_orders.get(order.id, []))]\n\n    def _fetch_duplicate_orders(self):\n        \"\"\" Fectch duplicated orders.\n\n        :return: Dictionary mapping order to it's related duplicated orders.\n        :rtype: dict\n        \"\"\"\n        orders = self.filtered(lambda order: order.id and order.client_order_ref)\n        if not orders:\n            return {}\n\n        used_fields = (\n            'company_id',\n            'partner_id',\n            'client_order_ref',\n            'origin',\n            'date_order',\n            'state',\n        )\n        self.env['sale.order'].flush_model(used_fields)\n\n        result = self.env.execute_query(SQL(\"\"\"\n            SELECT\n                sale_order.id AS order_id,\n                array_agg(duplicate_order.id) AS duplicate_ids\n              FROM sale_order\n              JOIN sale_order AS duplicate_order\n                ON sale_order.company_id =…38103 chars
