_autoconfirm_picking(self):\n        \"\"\" Automatically run `action_confirm` on `self` if one of the\n        picking's move was added after the initial\n        call to `action_confirm`. Note that `action_confirm` will only work on draft moves.\n        \"\"\"\n        for picking in self:\n            if picking.state in ('done', 'cancel'):\n                continue\n            if not picking.move_ids and not picking.package_level_ids:\n                continue\n            if any(move.additional for move in picking.move_ids):\n                picking.action_confirm()\n        to_confirm = self.move_ids.filtered(lambda m: m.state == 'draft' and m.quantity)\n        to_confirm._action_confirm()\n\n    def _get_moves_to_backorder(self):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        return self.move_ids.filtered(lambda x: x.state not in ('done', 'cancel'))\n\n    def _create_backorder_picking(self):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        return self.copy({\n            'name': '/',\n            'move_ids': [],\n            'move_line_ids': [],\n            'backorder_id': self.id,\n            'return_id': self.return_id.id,\n        })\n\n    def _create_backorder(self, backorder_moves=None):\n        \"\"\" This method is called when the user chose to create a backorder. It will create a new\n        picking, the backorder, and move the stock.moves that are not `done` or `cancel` into it.\n        \"\"\"\n        backorders = self.env['stock.picking']\n        bo_to_assign = self.env['stock.picking']\n        for picking in self:\n            if backorder_moves:\n                moves_to_backorder = backorder_moves.filtered(lambda m: m.picking_id == picking)\n            else:\n                moves_to_backorder = picking._get_moves_to_backorder()\n            moves_to_backorder._recompute_state()\n            if moves_to_backorder:\n                backorder_picking = picking._create_backorder_picking()\n                moves_to_backorder.write({'picking_id': backorder_picking.id, 'picked': False})\n                moves_to_backorder.move_line_ids.package_level_id.write({'picking_id': backorder_picking.id})\n                moves_to_backorder.mapped('move_line_ids').write({'picking_id': backorder_picking.id})\n                backorders |= backorder_picking\n                backorder_picking.user_id = False\n                picking.message_post(\n                    body=_('The backorder %s has been created.', backorder_picking._get_html_link())\n                )\n                if backorder_picking.picking_type_id.reservation_method == 'at_confirm':\n                    bo_to_assign |= backorder_picking\n        if bo_to_assign:\n            bo_to_assign.action_assign()\n        return backorders\n\n    def _log_activity_get_documents(self, orig_obj_changes, stream_field, stream, groupby_method=False):\n        \"\"\" Generic method to log activity. To use with\n        _log_activity method. It either log on uppermost\n        ongoing documents or following documents. This method\n        find all the documents and responsible for which a note\n        has to be log. It also generate a rendering_context in\n        order to render a specific note by documents containing\n        only the information relative to the document it. For example\n        we don't want to notify a picking on move that it doesn't\n        contain.\n\n        :param orig_obj_changes dict: contain a record as key and the\n        change on this record as value.\n        eg: {'move_id': (new product_uom_qty, old product_uom_qty)}\n        :param stream_field string: It has to be a field of the\n        records that are register in the key of 'orig_obj_changes'\n        eg: 'move_dest_ids' if we use move as record (previous example)\n            - 'UP' if we want to log on the upper most ongoing\n            documents.\n            - 'DOWN' if we want to log on following documents.\n        :param groupby_method: Only need when\n        stream is 'DOWN', it should group by tuple(object on\n        which the activity is log, the responsible for this object)\n        \"\"\"\n        if self.env.context.get('skip_activity'):\n            return {}\n        move_to_orig_object_rel = {co: ooc for ooc in orig_obj_changes.keys() for co in ooc[stream_field]}\n        origin_objects = self.env[list(orig_obj_changes.keys())[0]._name].concat(*list(orig_obj_changes.keys()))\n        # The purpose here is to group each destination object by\n        # (document to log, responsible) no matter the stream direction.\n        # example:\n        # {'(delivery_picking_1, admin)': stock.move(1, 2)\n        #  '(delivery_picking_2, admin)': stock.move(3)}\n        visited_documents = {}\n        if stream == 'DOWN':\n            if groupby_method:\n                grouped_moves = groupby(origin_objects.mapped(stream_field), key=groupby_method)\n            else:\n                raise AssertionError('You have to define a groupby method and pass them as arguments.')\n        elif stream == 'UP':\n            # When using upstream document it is required to define\n            # _get_upstream_documents_and_responsibles on\n            # destination objects in order to ascend documents.\n            grouped_moves = {}\n            for visited_move in origin_objects.mapped(stream_field):\n                for document, responsible, visited in visited_move._get_upstream_documents_and_responsibles(self.env[visited_move._name]):\n                    if grouped_moves.get((document, responsible)):\n                        grouped_moves[(document, responsible)] |= visited_move\n                        visited_documents[(document, responsible)] |= visited\n                    else:\n                        grouped_moves[(document, responsible)] = visited_move\n                        visited_documents[(document, responsible)] = visited\n            grouped_moves = grouped_moves.items()\n        else:\n            raise AssertionError('Unknown stream.')\n\n        documents = {}\n        for (parent, responsible), moves in grouped_moves:\n            if not parent:\n                continue\n            moves = self.env[moves[0]._name].concat(*moves)\n            # Get the note\n            rendering_context = {move: (orig_object, orig_obj_changes[orig_object]) for move in moves for orig_object in move_to_orig_object_rel[move]}\n            if visited_documents:\n                documents[(parent, responsible)] = rendering_context, visited_documents.values()\n            else:\n                documents[(parent, responsible)] = rendering_context\n        return documents\n\n    def _log_activity(self, render_method, documents):\n        \"\"\" Log a note for each documents, responsible pair in\n        documents passed as argument. The render_method is then\n        call in order to use a template and render it with a\n        rendering_context.\n\n        :param documents dict: A tuple (document, responsible) as key.\n        An activity will be log by key. A rendering_context as value.\n        If used with _log_activity_get_documents. In 'DOWN' stream\n        cases the rendering_context will be a dict with format:\n        {'stream_object': ('orig_object', new_qty, old_qty)}\n        'UP' stream will add all the documents browsed in order to\n        get the final/upstream document present in the key.\n        :param render_method method: a static function that will generate\n        the html note to log on the activity. The render_method should\n        use the args:\n            - rendering_context dict: value of the documents argument\n        the render_method should return a string with an html format\n        :param stream string:\n        \"\"\"\n        for (parent, responsible), rendering_context in documents.items():\n            note = render_method(rendering_context)\n            parent.sudo().activity_schedule(\n                'mail.mail_activity_data_warning',\n                date.today(),\n                note=note,\n                user_id=responsible.id or SUPERUSER_ID\n            )\n\n    def _log_less_quantities_than_expected(self, moves):\n        \"\"\" Log an activity on picking that follow moves. The note\n        contains the moves changes and all the impacted picking.\n\n        :param dict moves: a dict with a move as key and tuple with\n        new and old quantity as value. eg: {move_1 : (4, 5)}\n        \"\"\"\n        def _keys_in_groupby(move):\n            \"\"\" group by picking and the responsible for the product the\n            move.\n            \"\"\"\n            return (move.picking_id, move.product_id.responsible_id)\n\n        def _render_note_exception_quantity(rendering_context):\n            \"\"\" :param rendering_context:\n            {'move_dest': (move_orig, (new_qty, old_qty))}\n            \"\"\"\n            origin_moves = self.env['stock.move'].browse([move.id for move_orig in rendering_context.values() for move in move_orig[0]])\n            origin_picking = origin_moves.mapped('picking_id')\n            move_dest_ids = self.env['stock.move'].concat(*rendering_context.keys())\n            impacted_pickings = origin_picking._get_impacted_pickings(move_dest_ids) - move_dest_ids.mapped('picking_id')\n            values = {\n                'origin_picking': origin_picking,\n                'moves_information': rendering_context.values(),\n                'impacted_pickings': impacted_pickings,\n            }\n            return self.env['ir.qweb']._render('stock.exception_on_picking', values)\n\n        documents = self._log_activity_get_documents(moves, 'move_dest_ids', 'DOWN', _keys_in_groupby)\n        documents = self._less_quantities_than_expected_add_documents(moves, documents)\n        self._log_activity(_render_note_exception_quantity, documents)\n\n    def _less_quantities_than_expected_add_documents(self, moves, documents):\n        return documents\n\n    def _get_impacted_pickings(self, moves):\n        \"\"\" This function is used in _log_less_quantities_than_expected\n        the purpose is to notify a user with all the pickings that are\n        impacted by an action on a chained move.\n        param: 'moves' contain moves that belong to a common picking.\n        return: all the pickings that contain a destination moves\n        (direct and indirect) from the moves given as arguments.\n        \"\"\"\n\n        def _explore(impacted_pickings, explored_moves, moves_to_explore):\n            for move in moves_to_explore:\n                if move not in explored_moves:\n                    impacted_pickings |= move.picking_id\n                    explored_moves |= move\n                    moves_to_explore |= move.move_dest_ids\n            moves_to_explore = moves_to_explore - explored_moves\n            if moves_to_explore:\n                return _explore(impacted_pickings, explored_moves, moves_to_explore)\n            else:\n                return impacted_pickings\n\n        return _explore(self.env['stock.picking'], self.env['stock.move'], moves)\n\n    def _pre_put_in_pack_hook(self, move_line_ids):\n        return self._check_destinations(move_line_ids)\n\n    def _check_destinations(self, move_line_ids):\n        if len(move_line_ids.mapped('location_dest_id')) > 1:\n            view_id = self.env.ref('stock.stock_package_destination_form_view').id\n            wiz = self.env['stock.package.destination'].create({\n                'picking_id': self.id,\n                'location_dest_id': move_line_ids[0].location_dest_id.id,\n            })\n            return {\n                'name': _('Choose destination location'),\n                'view_mode': 'form',\n                'res_model': 'stock.package.destination',\n                'view_id': view_id,\n                'views': [(view_id, 'form')],\n                'type': 'ir.actions.act_window',\n                'res_id': wiz.id,\n                'target': 'new',\n                'context': {\n                    'move_lines_to_pack_ids': move_line_ids.ids,\n                }\n            }\n        else:\n            return {}\n\n    def _put_in_pack(self, move_line_ids):\n        package = self._get_put_in_pack_package()\n        package_type = move_line_ids.move_id.product_packaging_id.package_type_id\n        if len(package_type) == 1:\n            package.package_type_id = package_type\n        if len(move_line_ids) == 1:\n            default_dest_location = move_line_ids._get_default_dest_location()\n            move_line_ids.location_dest_id = default_dest_location._get_putaway_strategy(\n                product=move_line_ids.product_id,\n                quantity=move_line_ids.quantity,\n                package=package)\n        move_line_ids.write({\n            'result_package_id': package.id,\n        })\n        if len(self) == 1:\n            self.env['stock.package_level'].with_context(from_put_in_pack=True).create({\n                'package_id': package.id,\n                'picking_id': self.id,\n                'location_id': False,\n                'location_dest_id': move_line_ids.location_dest_id.id,\n                'move_line_ids': [(6, 0, move_line_ids.ids)],\n                'company_id': self.company_id.id,\n            })\n        return package\n\n    def _get_put_in_pack_package(self):\n        return self.env['stock.quant.package'].create({})\n\n    def _post_put_in_pack_hook(self, package_id):\n        if package_id and self.picking_type_id.auto_print_package_label:\n            if self.picking_type_id.package_label_to_print == 'pdf':\n                action = self.env.ref(\"stock.action_report_quant_package_barcode_small\").report_action(package_id.id, config=False)\n            elif self.picking_type_id.package_label_to_print == 'zpl':\n                action = self.env.ref(\"stock.label_package_template\").report_action(package_id.id, config=False)\n            if action:\n                action.update({'close_on_report_download': True})\n                clean_action(action, self.env)\n                return action\n        return package_id\n\n    def _package_move_lines(self, batch_pack=False, move_lines_to_pack=False):\n        # in theory, the picking_type should always be the same (i.e. for batch transfers),\n        # but customizations may bypass it and cause unexpected behavior so we avoid allowing those situations\n        if len(self.picking_type_id) > 1:\n            raise UserError(_(\"You cannot pack products into the same package when they are from different transfers with different operation types.\"))\n        quantity_move_line_ids = self.move_line_ids.filtered(\n            lambda ml:\n                float_compare(ml.quantity, 0.0, precision_rounding=ml.product_uom_id.rounding) > 0 and\n                not ml.result_package_id\n        )\n        move_line_ids = quantity_move_line_ids.filtered(lambda ml: ml.picked)\n        if not move_line_ids:\n            move_line_ids = quantity_move_line_ids\n        if move_lines_to_pack:\n            move_line_ids = move_line_ids & move_lines_to_pack\n        return move_line_ids\n\n    def action_put_in_pack(self, move_lines_to_pack=False):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        if self.env.context.get('sml_specific_default'):\n            self = self.with_context(clean_context(self.env.context))\n        if self.state not in ('done', 'cancel'):\n            move_line_ids = self._package_move_lines(move_lines_to_pack=move_lines_to_pack)\n            if move_line_ids:\n                res = self._pre_put_in_pack_hook(move_line_ids)\n                if not res:\n                    package = self._put_in_pack(move_line_ids)\n                    return self._post_put_in_pack_hook(package)\n                return res\n            raise UserError(_(\"There is nothing eligible to put in a pack. Either there are no quantities to put in a pack or all products are already in a pack.\"))\n\n    @api.model\n    def get_action_click_graph(self):\n        return self._get_action(\"stock.action_picking_tree_graph\")\n\n    def _get_action(self, action_xmlid):\n        action = self.env[\"ir.actions.actions\"]._for_xml_id(action_xmlid)\n        context = self.env.context\n        context.update(literal_eval(action['context']))\n        action['context'] = context\n\n        action['help'] = self.env['ir.ui.view']._render_template(\n            'stock.help_message_template', {\n                'picking_type_code': context.get('restricted_picking_type_code') or self.picking_type_code,\n            }\n        )\n\n        return action\n\n    @api.model\n    def get_action_picking_tree_incoming(self):\n        return self._get_action('stock.action_picking_tree_incoming')\n\n    @api.model\n    def get_action_picking_tree_outgoing(self):\n        return self._get_action('stock.action_picking_tree_outgoing')\n\n    @api.model\n    def get_action_picking_tree_internal(self):\n        return self._get_action('stock.action_picking_tree_internal')\n\n    @api.model\n    def calculate_date_category(self, datetime):\n        \"\"\"\n        Assigns given datetime to one of the following categories:\n        - \"before\"\n        - \"yesterday\"\n        - \"today\"\n        - \"day_1\" (tomorrow)\n        - \"day_2\" (the day after tomorrow)\n        - \"after\"\n\n        The categories are based on current user's timezone (e.g. \"today\" will last\n        between 00:00 and 23:59 local time). The datetime itself is assumed to be\n        in UTC. If the datetime is falsy, this function returns \"\".\n        \"\"\"\n        start_today = fields.Datetime.context_timestamp(\n            self.env.user, fields.Datetime.now()\n        ).replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)\n\n        start_yesterday = start_today + timedelta(days=-1)\n        start_day_1 = start_today + timedelta(days=1)\n        start_day_2 = start_today + timedelta(days=2)\n        start_day_3 = start_today + timedelta(days=3)\n\n        date_category = \"\"\n\n        if datetime:\n            datetime = datetime.astimezone(pytz.UTC)\n            if datetime < start_yesterday:\n                date_category = \"before\"\n            elif datetime >= start_yesterday and datetime < start_today:\n                date_category = \"yesterday\"\n            elif datetime >= start_today and datetime < start_day_1:\n                date_category = \"today\"\n            elif datetime >= start_day_1 and datetime < start_day_2:\n                date_category = \"day_1\"\n            elif datetime >= start_day_2 and datetime < start_day_3:\n                date_category = \"day_2\"\n            else:\n                date_category = \"after\"\n\n        return date_category\n\n    @api.model\n    def date_category_to_domain(self, date_category):\n        \"\"\"\n        Given a date category, returns a list of tuples of operator and value\n        that can be used in a domain to filter records based on their scheduled date.\n\n        Args:\n            date_category (str): The date category to use for the computation.\n                Allowed values are:\n                * \"before\"\n                * \"yesterday\"\n                * \"today\"\n                * \"day_1\"\n                * \"day_2\"\n                * \"after\"\n\n        Returns:\n            a list of tuples:\n                each tuple consists of an operator and a value that can be used in\n                a domain to filter records based on their scheduled date.\n                The operator can be \"<\" or \">=\". The value is a datetime object.\n                If an incorrect date category is passed, this method returns None.\n        \"\"\"\n        start_today = fields.Datetime.context_timestamp(\n            self.env.user, fields.Datetime.now()\n        ).replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)\n\n        start_today = start_today.astimezone(pytz.UTC)\n\n        start_yesterday = start_today + timedelta(days=-1)\n        start_day_1 = start_today + timedelta(days=1)\n        start_day_2 = start_today + timedelta(days=2)\n        start_day_3 = start_today + timedelta(days=3)\n\n        date_category_to_search_domain = {\n            \"before\": [(\"<\", start_yesterday)],\n            \"yesterday\": [(\">=\", start_yesterday), (\"<\", start_today)],\n            \"today\": [(\">=\", start_today), (\"<\", start_day_1)],\n            \"day_1\": [(\">=\", start_day_1), (\"<\", start_day_2)],\n            \"day_2\": [(\">=\", start_day_2), (\"<\", start_day_3)],\n            \"after\": [(\">=\", start_day_3)],\n        }\n\n        return date_category_to_search_domain.get(date_category)\n\n    def button_scrap(self):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        view = self.env.ref('stock.stock_scrap_form_view2')\n        products = self.env['product.product']\n        for move in self.move_ids:\n            if move.state not in ('draft', 'cancel') and move.product_id.type == 'consu':\n                products |= move.product_id\n        return {\n            'name': _('Scrap Products'),\n            'view_mode': 'form',\n            'res_model': 'stock.scrap',\n            'view_id': view.id,\n            'views': [(view.id, 'form')],\n            'type': 'ir.actions.act_window',\n            'context': {'default_picking_id': self.id, 'product_ids': products.ids, 'default_company_id': self.company_id.id},\n            'target': 'new',\n        }\n\n    def action_see_move_scrap(self):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        action = self.env[\"ir.actions.actions\"]._for_xml_id(\"stock.action_stock_scrap\")\n        scraps = self.env['stock.scrap'].search([('picking_id', '=', self.id)])\n        action['domain'] = [('id', 'in', scraps.ids)]\n        action['context'] = dict(self._context, create=False)\n        return action\n\n    def action_see_packages(self):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        action = self.env[\"ir.actions.actions\"]._for_xml_id(\"stock.action_package_view\")\n        packages = self.move_line_ids.mapped('result_package_id')\n        action['domain'] = [('id', 'in', packages.ids)]\n        action['context'] = {'picking_id': self.id}\n        return action\n\n    def action_picking_move_tree(self):\n        action = self.env[\"ir.actions.actions\"]._for_xml_id(\"stock.stock_move_action\")\n        action['views'] = [\n            (self.env.ref('stock.view_picking_move_tree').id, 'list'),\n        ]\n        action['context'] = self.env.context\n        action['domain'] = [('picking_id', 'in', self.ids)]\n        return action\n\n    def action_view_reception_report(self):\n        return self.env[\"ir.actions.actions\"]._for_xml_id(\"stock.stock_reception_action\")\n\n    def action_open_label_layout(self):\n        view = self.env.ref('stock.product_label_layout_form_picking')\n        return {\n            'name': _('Choose Labels Layout'),\n            'type': 'ir.actions.act_window',\n            'res_model': 'product.label.layout',\n            'views': [(view.id, 'form')],\n            'target': 'new',\n            'context': {\n                'default_product_ids': self.move_ids.product_id.ids,\n                'default_move_ids': self.move_ids.ids,\n                'default_move_quantity': 'move'},\n        }\n\n    def action_open_label_type(self):\n        if self.env.user.has_group('stock.group_production_lot') and self.move_line_ids.lot_id:\n            view = self.env.ref('stock.picking_label_type_form')\n            return {\n                'name': _('Choose Type of Labels To Print'),\n                'type': 'ir.actions.act_window',\n                'res_model': 'picking.label.type',\n                'views': [(view.id, 'form')],\n                'target': 'new',\n                'context': {'default_picking_ids': self.ids},\n            }\n        return self.action_open_label_layout()\n\n    def _attach_sign(self):\n        \"\"\" Render the delivery report in pdf and attach it to the picking in `self`. \"\"\"\n        self.ensure_one()\n        report = self.env['ir.actions.report']._render_qweb_pdf(\"stock.action_report_delivery\", self.id)\n        filename = \"%s_signed_delivery_slip\" % self.name\n        if self.partner_id:\n            message = _('Order signed by %s', self.partner_id.name)\n        else:\n            message = _('Order signed')\n        self.message_post(\n            attachments=[('%s.pdf' % filename, report[0])],\n            body=message,\n        )\n        return True\n\n    def action_see_returns(self):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        if len(self.return_ids) == 1:\n            return {\n                \"type\": \"ir.actions.act_window\",\n                \"res_model\": \"stock.picking\",\n                \"views\": [[False, \"form\"]],\n                \"res_id\": self.return_ids.id\n            }\n        return {\n            'name': _('Returns'),\n            \"type\": \"ir.actions.act_window\",\n            \"res_model\": \"stock.picking\",\n            \"views\": [[False, \"list\"], [False, \"form\"]],\n            \"domain\": [('id', 'in', self.return_ids.ids)],\n        }\n\n    def _get_report_lang(self):\n        return self.move_ids and self.move_ids[0].partner_id.lang or self.partner_id.lang or self.env.lang\n\n    def _get_autoprint_report_actions(self):\n        report_actions = []\n        pickings_to_print = self.filtered(lambda p: p.picking_type_id.auto_print_delivery_slip)\n        if pickings_to_print:\n            action = self.env.ref(\"stock.action_report_delivery\").report_action(pickings_to_print.ids, config=False)\n            clean_action(action, self.env)\n            report_actions.append(action)\n        pickings_print_return_slip = self.filtered(lambda p: p.picking_type_id.auto_print_return_slip)\n        if pickings_print_return_slip:\n            action = self.env.ref(\"stock.return_label_report\").report_action(pickings_print_return_slip.ids, config=False)\n            clean_action(action, self.env)\n            report_actions.append(action)\n\n        if self.env.user.has_group('stock.group_reception_report'):\n            reception_reports_to_print = self.filtered(\n                lambda p: p.picking_type_id.auto_print_reception_report\n                          and p.picking_type_id.code != 'outgoing'\n                          and p.move_ids.move_dest_ids\n            )\n            if reception_reports_to_print:\n                action = self.env.ref('stock.stock_reception_report_action').report_action(reception_reports_to_print, config=False)\n                clean_action(action, self.env)\n                report_actions.append(action)\n            reception_labels_to_print = self.filtered(lambda p: p.picking_type_id.auto_print_reception_report_labels and p.picking_type_id.code != 'outgoing')\n            if reception_labels_to_print:\n                moves_to_print = reception_labels_to_print.move_ids.move_dest_ids\n                if moves_to_print:\n                    # needs to be string to support python + js calls to report\n                    quantities = ','.join(str(qty) for qty in moves_to_print.mapped(lambda m: price_unit=line_amount_after_discount,\n                    quantity=1.0,\n                    currency_id=currency,\n                    sign=1,\n                    special_mode='total_excluded',\n                    special_type='early_payment',\n                ))\n        return epd_lines\n\n    @api.depends('order_line.invoice_lines')\n    def _get_invoiced(self):\n        # The invoice_ids This is necessary since such a refund is not\n        # directly linked to the SO.\n        for order in self:\n            invoices = order.order_line.invoice_lines.move_id.filtered(lambda r: r.move_type in ('out_invoice', 'out_refund'))\n            order.invoice_ids = invoices\n            order.invoice_count = len(invoices)\n\n    def _search_invoice_ids(self, operator, value):\n        if operator == 'in' and value:\n            self.env.cr.execute(\"\"\"\n                SELECT array_agg(so.id)\n                    FROM sale_order so\n                    JOIN sale_order_line sol ON sol.order_id = so.id\n                    JOIN sale_order_line_invoice_rel soli_rel ON soli_rel.order_line_id = sol.id\n                    JOIN account_move_line aml ON aml.id = soli_rel.invoice_line_id\n                    JOIN account_move am ON am.id = aml.move_id\n                WHERE\n                    am.move_type in ('out_invoice', 'out_refund') AND\n                    am.id = ANY(%s)\n            \"\"\", (list(value),))\n            so_ids = self.env.cr.fetchone()[0] or []\n            return [('id', 'in', so_ids)]\n        elif operator == '=' and not value:\n            # Possible statuses:\n        - no: if the SO is not in status 'sale' or 'done', we consider that there is nothing to\n          invoice. 'sale')\n        (self - confirmed_orders).invoice_status = 'no'\n        if not confirmed_orders:\n            return\n        lines_domain = [('is_downpayment', '=', False), ('display_type', '=', invoiceable_lines = order.order_line.filtered_domain(invoiceable_domain)\n                    special_lines = invoiceable_lines.filtered(\n                        lambda sol: not sol._can_be_invoiced_alone()\n                    )\n                    if invoiceable_lines == special_lines:\n                        order.invoice_status = 'no'\n                    else:\n                        order.invoice_status = 'to invoice'\n                else:\n                    order.invoice_status = 'to invoice'\n            elif line_invoice_status and all(invoice_status == 'invoiced' for invoice_status in line_invoice_status):\n                order.invoice_status = 'invoiced'\n            elif line_invoice_status and all(invoice_status in ('invoiced', 'upselling') for receivable_line = move.line_ids.filtered(\n                        lambda aml: aml.account_id.account_type == 'asset_receivable')[:1]\n                    product_lines = move.line_ids.filtered(\n move.line_ids = line_commands\n\n            move.message_post_with_source(\n                'mail.message_origin_link',\n                render_values={'self': move, 'origin': move.line_ids.sale_line_ids.order_id},\n                subtype_xmlid='mail.mt_note',\n            )\n        return moves\n\n    # MAIL #\n\n    def _discard_tracking(self):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        return (\n            self.state == 'draft'\n            and request and request.env.context.get('catalog_skip_tracking')\n        )\n\n    def _track_finalize(self):\n        \"\"\" Override of `mail` to prevent logging changes when the SO is in a draft state. \"\"\"\n        if (len(self) == 1\n            # The method _track_finalize is sometimes called too early or super()._track_finalize()\n\n    @api.returns('mail.message', lambda value: value.id)\n    def message_post(self, **kwargs):\n        if self.env.context.get('mark_so_as_sent'):\n            self.filtered(lambda o: o.state == 'draft').with_context(tracking_disable=True).write({'state': 'sent'})\n        so_ctx = {'mail_post_autofollow': self.env.context.get('mail_post_autofollow', [])\n        return super(SaleOrder, self.with_context(**so_ctx)).message_post(**kwargs)\n\n    def _notify_get_recipients_groups(self, message, model_description, msg_vals=None):\n        \"\"\" Give access button to users and portal customer as portal is integrated\n        in sale. Customer and portal group have probably no right to see\n        the document so they don't have the access button. \"\"\"\n        groups = super()._notify_get_recipients_groups(\n            message, model_description, msg_vals=msg_vals\n        )\n        if not self:\n            return groups\n\n        self.ensure_one()\n        if self._context.get('proforma'):\n            for group in [g for g in groups if g[0] in ('portal_customer', 'portal', 'follower', 'customer')]:\n                group[2]['has_button_access'] = False\n            return groups\n        local_msg_vals = dict(msg_vals or {})\n\n        # portal customers have full access (existence not granted, depending on partner_id)\n        try:\n            customer_portal_group = next(group for group in groups if group[0] == 'portal_customer')\n        except StopIteration:\n            pass\n        else:\n            access_opt = customer_portal_group[2].setdefault('button_access', {})\n            is_tx_pending = self.get_portal_last_transaction().state == 'pending'\n            if self._has_to_be_signed():\n                if self._has_to_be_paid():\n                    access_opt['title'] = _(\"View Quotation\") if is_tx_pending else _(\"Sign & Pay Quotation\")\n                else:\n                    access_opt['title'] = _(\"Accept & Sign Quotation\")\n            elif self._has_to_be_paid() and not is_tx_pending:\n                access_opt['title'] = _(\"Accept & Pay Quotation\")\n            elif self.state in ('draft', 'sent'):\n                access_opt['title'] = _(\"View Quotation\")\n\n        return groups\n\n    def _notify_by_email_prepare_rendering_context(self, message, msg_vals=False, model_description=False,\n                                                   force_email_company=False, force_email_lang=False):\n        render_context = super()._notify_by_email_prepare_rendering_context(\n            message, msg_vals, model_description=model_description,\n            force_email_company=force_email_company, force_email_lang=force_email_lang\n        )\n        lang_code = render_context.get('lang')\n        record = render_context['record']\n        subtitles = [f\"{record.name} - {record.partner_id.name}\" if record.partner_id.name else record.name]\n        if self.amount_total:\n            # Instead SMS will\n        fallback on partner-based computation using ``_mail_get_partner_fields``. \"\"\"\n        return []\n\n    def _track_subtype(self, init_values):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        if 'state' in init_values and self.state == 'sale':\n            return self.env.ref('sale.mt_order_confirmed')\n        elif 'state' in init_values and self.state == 'sent':\n            return self.env.ref('sale.mt_order_sent')\n        return super()._track_subtype(init_values)\n\n    def _message_get_suggested_recipients(self):\n        recipients = super()._message_get_suggested_recipients()\n        if self.partner_id:\n            self._message_add_suggested_recipient(\n                recipients, partner=self.partner_id, reason=_(\"Customer\")\n            )\n        return recipients\n\n    def _get_model_description(self, model_name):\n        if not self:\n            return super()._get_model_description(model_name)\n        return self.type_name\n\n    # PAYMENT #\n\n    def _force_lines_to_invoice_policy_order(self):\n        \"\"\"Force the qty_to_invoice to be automatically\n        invoice the full SO when it's paid.\n        \"\"\"\n        for line in self.order_line:\n            if line.state == 'sale':\n                # No need to set 0 as it is transactions.\n        return self.transaction_ids.sudo().action_capture()\n\n    def payment_action_void(self):\n        \"\"\" Void all transactions linked to this sale order. \"\"\"\n False\n\n        return self.order_line.filtered(show_line)\n\n    def _get_default_payment_link_values(self):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        amount_max = self.amount_total - self.amount_paid\n\n        # Always default to the minimum value needed to confirm the order:\n        # - order is not confirmed yet\n        # - can be confirmed online\n        # - we have still not paid enough for confirmation.\n        prepayment_amount = self._get_prepayment_required_amount()\n        if (\n            self.state in ('draft', 'sent')\n            and self.require_payment\n            and self.currency_id.compare_amounts(prepayment_amount, self.amount_paid) > 0\n        ):\n            amount = prepayment_amount - self.amount_paid\n        else:\n            amount = amount_max\n\n        return {\n            'currency_id': self.currency_id.id,\n            'partner_id': self.partner_invoice_id.id,\n            'amount': amount,\n            'amount_max': amount_max,\n            'amount_paid': self.amount_paid,\n        }\n\n    # EDI #\n\n    def create_document_from_attachment(self, attachment_ids):\n        \"\"\" Create the sale orders from given attachment_ids and redirect newly create order view.\n\n        :param list attachment_ids: List of attachments process.\n        :return: An action redirecting to related sale order view.\n        :rtype: dict\n        \"\"\"\n        orders = self._create_order_from_attachment(attachment_ids)\n        return orders._get_records_action(name=_(\"Generated Orders\"))\n\n    @api.model\n    def _create_order_from_attachment(self, attachment_ids):\n        \"\"\" Create the sale orders from given attachment_ids and fill data by extracting detail\n        from attachments and return generated orders.\n\n        :param list attachment_ids: List of attachments process.\n        :return: Recordset of order.\n        \"\"\"\n        attachments = self.env['ir.attachment'].browse(attachment_ids)\n        if not attachments:\n            raise UserError(_(\"No attachment was provided\"))\n\n        orders = self.browse()\n        for attachment in attachments:\n            order = self.create({\n                'partner_id': self.env.user.partner_id.id,\n            })\n            order._extend_with_attachments(attachment)\n            orders |= order\n            order.message_post(attachment_ids=attachment.ids)\n            attachment.write({'res_model': self._name, 'res_id': order.id})\n\n        return orders\n\n    def _extend_with_attachments(self, attachment):\n        \"\"\" Main entry point to extend/enhance order with attachment.\n\n        :param attachment: A recordset of ir.attachment.\n        :returns: None\n        \"\"\"\n        self.ensure_one()\n\n        file_data = attachment._unwrap_edi_attachments()[0]\n        decoder = self._get_order_edi_decoder(file_data)\n        if decoder:\n            try:\n                with self.env.cr.savepoint():\n                    decoder(self, file_data)\n            except RedirectWarning:\n                raise\n            except Exception:\n                message = _(\n                    \"Error importing attachment '%(file_name)s' as order (decoder=%(decoder)s)\",\n                    file_name=file_data['filename'],\n                    decoder=decoder.__name__,\n                )\n                self.with_user(SUPERUSER_ID).message_post(body=message)\n                _logger.exception(message)\n\n        if file_data.get('on_close'):\n            file_data['on_close']()\n        return True\n\n    def _get_order_edi_decoder(self, file_data):\n        \"\"\" To be extended with decoding capabilities of order data from file data.\n\n        :returns:  Function to be later used to import the file.\n                   Function' args:\n                   - order: sale.order\n                   - file_data: attachemnt information / value\n                   returns True if was able to process the order\n        \"\"\"\n        if file_data['type'] in ('pdf', 'binary'):\n            return lambda *args: False\n        return\n\n    # PORTAL #\n\n    def _has_to_be_signed(self):\n        \"\"\"A sale order has to be signed when:\n        - its state is 'draft' or `sent`\n        - it's not expired;\n        - it requires a signature;\n        - it's not already signed.\n\n        Note: self.ensure_one()\n\n        :return: Whether the sale order has to be signed.\n        :rtype: bool\n        \"\"\"\n        self.ensure_one()\n        return (\n            self.state in ['draft', 'sent']\n            and not self.is_expired\n            and self.require_signature\n line.product_custom_attribute_value_ids = False\n                continue\n            if not line.product_custom_attribute_value_ids:\n                continue\n            valid_values = line.product_id.product_tmpl_id.valid_product_template_attribute_line_ids.product_template_value_ids\n            # remove the is_custom values that don't belong to this template\n            for pacv in line.product_custom_attribute_value_ids:\n                if pacv.custom_product_template_attribute_value_id not in valid_values:\n                    line.product_custom_attribute_value_ids -= pacv\n\n    @api.depends('product_id')\n    def _compute_no_variant_attribute_values(self):\n        for line in self:\n            if not line.product_id:\n                line.product_no_variant_attribute_value_ids = False\n                continue\n            if not line.product_no_variant_attribute_value_ids:\n                continue\n            valid_values = line.product_id.product_tmpl_id.valid_product_template_attribute_line_ids.product_template_value_ids\n            # remove the no_variant attributes that don't belong to this template\n            for ptav in line.product_no_variant_attribute_value_ids:\n                if ptav._origin not in valid_values:\n                    line.product_no_variant_attribute_value_ids -= ptav\n\n    @api.depends('product_id', 'linked_line_id', 'linked_line_ids')\n    def _compute_name(self):\n        for line in self:\n            if not line.product_id and not line.is_downpayment:\n                continue\n\n            lang = line.order_id._get_lang()\n            if lang != self.env.lang:\n                line = line.with_context(lang=lang)\n\n            if line.product_id:\n                line.name = line._get_sale_order_line_multiline_description_sale()\n                continue\n\n            if line.is_downpayment:\n                line.name = line._get_downpayment_description()\n\n    def _get_sale_order_line_multiline_description_sale(self):\n        \"\"\" Compute a default multiline description for this sales order line.\n\n        In most cases the product description is enough but sometimes we need to append information that only\n        exists on the sale order line itself.\n        e.g:\n        - custom attributes and attributes that don't create variants, both introduced by the \"product configurator\"\n        - in event_sale we need to know specifically the sales order line as well as the product to generate the name:\n          the product is not sufficient because we also need to know the event_id and the event_ticket_id (both which belong to the sale order line).\n        \"\"\"\n        self.ensure_one()\n        description = (\n            self.product_id.get_product_multiline_description_sale()\n            + self._get_sale_order_line_multiline_description_variants()\n        )\n        if self.linked_line_id and not self.combo_item_id:\n            description += \"\\n\" + _(\"Option for: %s\", self.linked_line_id.product_id.display_name)\n        if self.linked_line_ids and self.product_type != 'combo':\n            description += \"\\n\" + \"\\n\".join([\n                _(\"Option: %s\", linked_line.product_id.display_name)\n                for linked_line in self.linked_line_ids\n            ])\n        return description\n\n    def _get_sale_order_line_multiline_description_variants(self):\n        \"\"\"When using no_variant attributes or is_custom values, the product\n        itself is not sufficient to create the description: we need to add\n        information about those special attributes and values.\n\n        :return: the description related to special variant attributes/values\n        :rtype: string\n        \"\"\"\n        no_variant_ptavs = self.product_no_variant_attribute_value_ids._origin.filtered(\n            # Only describe the attributes where a choice was made by the customer\n            lambda ptav: ptav.display_type == 'multi' or ptav.attribute_line_id.value_count > 1\n        )\n        if not self.product_custom_attribute_value_ids and not no_variant_ptavs:\n            return \"\"\n\n        name = \"\\n\"\n\n        custom_ptavs = self.product_custom_attribute_value_ids.custom_product_template_attribute_value_id\n        multi_ptavs = no_variant_ptavs.filtered(lambda ptav: ptav.display_type == 'multi').sorted()\n\n        # display the no_variant attributes, except those that are also\n        # displayed by a custom (avoid duplicate description)\n        for ptav in (no_variant_ptavs - multi_ptavs - custom_ptavs):\n            name += \"\\n\" + ptav.display_name\n\n        # display the selected values per attribute on a single for a multi checkbox\n        for pta, ptavs in groupby(multi_ptavs, lambda ptav: ptav.attribute_id):\n            name += \"\\n\" + _(\n                \"%(attribute)s: %(values)s\",\n                attribute=pta.name,\n                values=\", \".join(ptav.name for ptav in ptavs)\n            )\n\n        # Sort the values according to _order settings, because it doesn't work for virtual records in onchange\n        sorted_custom_ptav = self.product_custom_attribute_value_ids.custom_product_template_attribute_value_id.sorted()\n        for patv in sorted_custom_ptav:\n            pacv = self.product_custom_attribute_value_ids.filtered(lambda pcav: pcav.custom_product_template_attribute_value_id == patv)\n            name += \"\\n\" + pacv.display_name\n\n        return name\n\n    def _get_downpayment_description(self):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        if self.display_type:\n            return _(\"Down Payments\")\n\n        dp_state = self._get_downpayment_state()\n        name = _(\"Down Payment\")\n        if dp_state == 'draft':\n            name = _(\n                \"Down Payment: %(date)s (Draft)\",\n                date=format_date(self.env, self.create_date.date()),\n            )\n        elif dp_state == 'cancel':\n            name = _(\"Down Payment (Cancelled)\")\n        else:\n            invoice = self._get_invoice_lines().filtered(\n                lambda aml: aml.quantity >= 0\n            ).move_id.filtered(lambda move: move.move_type == 'out_invoice')\n            if len(invoice) == 1 and invoice.payment_reference and invoice.invoice_date:\n                name = _(\n                    \"Down Payment (ref: %(reference)s on %(date)s)\",\n                    reference=invoice.payment_reference,\n                    date=format_date(self.env, invoice.invoice_date),\n                )\n\n        return name\n\n    @api.depends('product_id')\n    def   ).display_name\n\n    @api.depends('display_type', 'product_id', 'product_packaging_qty')\n    def _compute_product_uom_qty(self):\n        for line in self:\n            if line.display_type:\n                line.product_uom_qty = 0.0\n                continue\n\n            if not line.product_packaging_id:\n                continue\n            packaging_uom = line.product_packaging_qty * qty_per_packaging, line.product_uom)\n            if float_compare(product_uom_qty, line.product_uom_qty, precision_rounding=line.product_uom.rounding) != 0:\n                line.product_uom_qty = product_uom_qty\n\n    @api.depends('product_id')\n    def _compute_product_uom(self):\n        for line in self:\n            if not line.product_uom or (line.product_id.uom_id.id != line.product_uom.id):\n                line.product_uom = line.product_id.uom_id\n\n    @api.depends('product_id', 'company_id')\n    def _compute_tax_id(self):\n        lines_by_company = defaultdict(lambda: self.env['sale.order.line'])\n        cached_taxes = {}\n        for line in self:\n            if line.product_type == 'combo':\n                line.tax_id = False\n                continue\n            lines_by_company[line.company_id] += line\n        for company, lines in lines_by_company.items():\n            for line in lines.with_company(company):\n                taxes = None\n                if line.product_id:\n                    taxes = line.product_id.taxes_id._filter_taxes_by_company(company)\n                if not line.product_id or not taxes:\n                    # Nothing to map\n                    line.tax_id = False\n                    continue\n                fiscal_position = line.order_id.fiscal_position_id\n                cache_key = (fiscal_position.id, company.id, tuple(taxes.ids))\n                cache_key += line._get_custom_compute_tax_cache_key()\n                if cache_key in cached_taxes:\n                    result = cached_taxes[cache_key]\n                else:\n                    result = fiscal_position.map_tax(taxes)\n                    cached_taxes[cache_key] = result\n                # If company_id is set, always filter taxes by the company\n                line.tax_id = result\n\n    def _get_custom_compute_tax_cache_key(self):\n        \"\"\"Hook method to be able to set/get cached taxes while computing them\"\"\"\n        return tuple()\n\n    @api.depends('product_id', 'product_uom', 'product_uom_qty')\n    def _compute_pricelist_item_id(self):\n        for line in self:\n            if not line.product_id or line.display_type or not line.order_id.pricelist_id:\n                line.pricelist_item_id = False\n            else:\n                line.pricelist_item_id = line.order_id.pricelist_id._get_product_rule(\n                    line.product_id,\n                    quantity=line.product_uom_qty or 1.0,\n                    uom=line.product_uom,\n                    date=line._get_order_date(),\n                )\n\n    @api.depends('product_id', 'product_uom', 'product_uom_qty')\n    def _compute_price_unit(self):\n        def has_manual_price(line):\n            # `line.currency_id` can be False for NewId records\n            currency = (\n                line.currency_id\n                or line.company_id.currency_id\n                or line.env.company.currency_id\n            )\n            return currency.compare_amounts(line.technical_price_unit, line.price_unit)\n\n        force_recompute = self.env.context.get('force_price_recomputation')\n        for line in self:\n            # Don't compute the price for deleted lines.\n            if not line.order_id:\n                continue\n            # check if the price has been manually set or there is already invoiced amount.\n            # if so, the price shouldn't change as it might have been manually edited.\n            if (\n                (not force_recompute and has_manual_price(line))\n                or line.qty_invoiced > 0\n                or (line.product_id.expense_policy == 'cost' and line.is_expense)\n            ):\n                continue\n            line = line.with_context(sale_write_from_compute=True)\n            if not line.product_uom or not line.product_id:\n                line.price_unit = 0.0\n                line.technical_price_unit = 0.0\n            else:\n                line._reset_price_unit()\n\n    def _reset_price_unit(self):\n        self.ensure_one()\n\n        line = self.with_company(self.company_id)\n        price = line._get_display_price()\n        product_taxes = line.product_id.taxes_id._filter_taxes_by_company(line.company_id)\n        price_unit = line.product_id._get_tax_included_unit_price_from_price(\n            price,\n            product_taxes=product_taxes,\n            fiscal_position=line.order_id.fiscal_position_id,\n        )\n        line.update({\n            'price_unit': price_unit,\n            'technical_price_unit': price_unit,\n        })\n\n    def _get_order_date(self):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        return self.order_id.date_order\n\n    def _get_display_price(self):\n        \"\"\"Compute the displayed unit price for a given line.\n\n        Overridden in custom flows:\n        * where the price is not specified by the pricelist\n        * where the discount is not specified by the pricelist\n\n        Note: self.ensure_one()\n        \"\"\"\n        self.ensure_one()\n\n        if self.product_type == 'combo':\n            return 0  # The display price of a combo line should always be 0.\n        if self.combo_item_id:\n            return self._get_combo_item_display_price()\n        return self._get_display_price_ignore_combo()\n\n    def _get_display_price_ignore_combo(self):\n        \"\"\" This helper method allows to compute the display price of a SOL, while ignoring combo\n        logic.\n\n        I.e. this method returns the display price of a SOL as if it were neither a combo line nor a\n        combo item line.\n        \"\"\"\n        self.ensure_one()\n\n        pricelist_price = self._get_pricelist_price()\n\n        if not self.pricelist_item_id._show_discount():\n            # No pricelist rule found => no discount from pricelist\n            return pricelist_price\n\n        base_price = self._get_pricelist_price_before_discount()\n\n        # negative discounts (= surcharge) are included in the display price\n        return max(base_price, pricelist_price)\n\n    def _get_pricelist_price(self):\n        \"\"\"Compute the price given by the pricelist for the given line information.\n\n        :return: the product sales price in the order currency (without taxes)\n        :rtype: float\n        \"\"\"\n        self.ensure_one()\n        self.product_id.ensure_one()\n\n        price = self.pricelist_item_id._compute_price(\n            product=self.product_id.with_context(**self._get_product_price_context()),\n            quantity=self.product_uom_qty or 1.0,\n            uom=self.product_uom,\n            date=self._get_order_date(),\n            currency=self.currency_id,\n        )\n\n        return price\n\n    def _get_product_price_context(self):\n        \"\"\"Gives the context for product price computation.\n\n        :return: additional context to consider extra prices from attributes in the base product price.\n        :rtype: dict\n        \"\"\"\n        self.ensure_one()\n        return self.product_id._get_product_price_context(\n            self.product_no_variant_attribute_value_ids,\n        )\n\n    def _get_pricelist_price_context(self):\n        \"\"\"DO NOT USE in new code, this contextual logic should be dropped or heavily refactored soon\"\"\"\n        self.ensure_one()\n        return {\n            'pricelist': self.order_id.pricelist_id.id,\n            'uom': self.product_uom.id,\n            'quantity': self.product_uom_qty,\n            'date': self._get_order_date(),\n        }\n\n    def _get_pricelist_price_before_discount(self):\n        \"\"\"Compute the price used as base for the pricelist price computation.\n\n        :return: the product sales price in the order currency (without taxes)\n        :rtype: float\n        \"\"\"\n        self.ensure_one()\n        self.product_id.ensure_one()\n\n        return self.pricelist_item_id._compute_price_before_discount(\n            product=self.product_id.with_context(**self._get_product_price_context()),\n            quantity=self.product_uom_qty or 1.0,\n            uom=self.product_uom,\n            date=self._get_order_date(),\n            currency=self.currency_id,\n        )\n\n    def _get_combo_item_display_price(self):\n        \"\"\" Compute the display price of this SOL's combo item.\n\n        A combo item's price is a fraction of its combo product's price (i.e. the product of type\n        `combo` which is referenced in this SOL's linked line). It is independent of the combo\n        item's product (i.e. the product referenced in this SOL). The combo's `base_price` will be\n        used to prorate the price of this combo with respect to the other combos in the combo\n        product.\n\n        Note: this method will throw if this …16555 chars truncated…r that there is nothing to\n          invoice. This is also the default value if the conditions of no other status is met.\n        - to invoice: we refer to the quantity to invoice of the line. Refer to method\n          `_compute_qty_to_invoice()` for more information on how this quantity is calculated.\n        - upselling: this is possible only for a product invoiced on ordered quantities for which\n          we delivered more than expected. The could arise if, for example, a project took more\n          time than expected but we decided not to invoice the extra cost to the client. This\n          occurs only in state 'sale', the upselling opportunity is removed from the list.\n        - invoiced: the quantity invoiced is larger or equal to the quantity ordered.\n        \"\"\"\n        precision = self.env['decimal.precision'].precision_get('Product Unit of Measure')\n        for line in self:\n            if line.state != 'sale':\n                line.invoice_status = 'no'\n            elif line.is_downpayment and line.untaxed_amount_to_invoice == 0:\n                line.invoice_status = 'invoiced'\n            elif not float_is_zero(line.qty_to_invoice, precision_digits=precision):\n                line.invoice_status = 'to invoice'\n            elif line.state == 'sale' and line.product_id.invoice_policy == 'order' and\\\n                    line.product_uom_qty >= 0.0 and\\\n                    float_compare(line.qty_delivered, line.product_uom_qty, precision_digits=precision) == 1:\n                line.invoice_status = 'upselling'\n            elif float_compare(line.qty_invoiced, line.product_uom_qty, precision_digits=precision) >= 0:\n                line.invoice_status = 'invoiced'\n            else:\n                line.invoice_status = 'no'\n\n    def _can_be_invoiced_alone(self):\n        \"\"\" Whether a given line is meaningful to invoice alone.\n\n        It is generally meaningless/confusing or even wrong to invoice some specific SOlines\n        (delivery, discounts, rewards, ...) without others, unless they are the only left to invoice\n        in the SO.\n        \"\"\"\n        self.ensure_one()\n        return self.product_id.id != self.company_id.sale_discount_product_id.id\n\n    def _is_discount_line(self):\n        self.ensure_one()\n        return self.product_id in self.company_id.sale_discount_product_id\n\n    @api.depends('invoice_lines', 'invoice_lines.price_total', 'invoice_lines.move_id.state', 'invoice_lines.move_id.move_type')\n    def _compute_untaxed_amount_invoiced(self):\n        \"\"\" Compute the untaxed amount already invoiced from the sale order line, taking the refund attached\n            the so line into account. This amount is computed as\n                SUM(inv_line.price_subtotal) - SUM(ref_line.price_subtotal)\n            where\n                `inv_line` is a customer invoice line linked to the SO line\n                `ref_line` is a customer credit note (refund) line linked to the SO line\n        \"\"\"\n        for line in self:\n            amount_invoiced = 0.0\n            for invoice_line in line._get_invoice_lines():\n                if invoice_line.move_id.state == 'posted' or invoice_line.move_id.payment_state == 'invoicing_legacy':\n                    invoice_date = invoice_line.move_id.invoice_date or fields.Date.today()\n                    if invoice_line.move_id.move_type == 'out_invoice':\n                        amount_invoiced += invoice_line.currency_id._convert(invoice_line.price_subtotal, line.currency_id, line.company_id, invoice_date)\n                    elif invoice_line.move_id.move_type == 'out_refund':\n                        amount_invoiced -= invoice_line.currency_id._convert(invoice_line.price_subtotal, line.currency_id, line.company_id, invoice_date)\n            line.untaxed_amount_invoiced = amount_invoiced\n\n    @api.depends('invoice_lines', 'invoice_lines.price_total', 'invoice_lines.move_id.state')\n    def _compute_amount_invoiced(self):\n        for line in self:\n            amount_invoiced = 0.0\n            for invoice_line in line._get_invoice_lines():\n                invoice = invoice_line.move_id\n                if invoice.state == 'posted' or invoice_line.move_id.payment_state == 'invoicing_legacy':\n                    invoice_date = invoice.invoice_date or fields.Date.context_today(self)\n                    amount_invoiced_unsigned = invoice_line.currency_id._convert(invoice_line.price_total, line.currency_id, line.company_id, invoice_date)\n                    amount_invoiced += amount_invoiced_unsigned * -invoice.direction_sign\n            line.amount_invoiced = amount_invoiced\n\n    @api.depends('state', 'product_id', 'untaxed_amount_invoiced', 'qty_delivered', 'product_uom_qty', 'price_unit')\n    def _compute_untaxed_amount_to_invoice(self):\n        \"\"\" Total of remaining amount to invoice on the sale order line (taxes excl.) as\n                total_sol - amount already invoiced\n            where Total_sol depends on the invoice policy of the product.\n\n            Note: Draft invoice are ignored on purpose, the 'to invoice' amount should\n            come only from the SO lines.\n        \"\"\"\n        for line in self:\n            amount_to_invoice = 0.0\n            if line.state == 'sale':\n                # Note: do not use price_subtotal field as it returns zero when the ordered quantity is\n                # zero. It causes problem for expense line (e.i.: ordered qty = 0, deli qty = 4,\n                # price_unit = 20 ; subtotal is zero), but when you can invoice the line, you see an\n                # amount and not zero. Since we compute untaxed amount, we can use directly the price\n                # reduce (to include discount) without using `compute_all()` method on taxes.\n                price_subtotal = 0.0\n                uom_qty_to_consider = line.qty_delivered if line.product_id.invoice_policy == 'delivery' else line.product_uom_qty\n                price_reduce = line.price_unit * (1 - (line.discount or 0.0) / 100.0)\n                price_subtotal = price_reduce * uom_qty_to_consider\n                if len(line.tax_id.filtered(lambda tax: tax.price_include)) > 0:\n                    # As included taxes are not excluded from the computed subtotal, `compute_all()` method\n                    # has to be called to retrieve the subtotal without them.\n                    # `price_reduce_taxexcl` cannot be used as it is computed from `price_subtotal` field. (see upper Note)\n                    price_subtotal = line.tax_id.compute_all(\n                        price_reduce,\n                        currency=line.currency_id,\n                        quantity=uom_qty_to_consider,\n                        product=line.product_id,\n                        partner=line.order_id.partner_shipping_id)['total_excluded']\n                inv_lines = line._get_invoice_lines()\n                if any(inv_lines.mapped(lambda l: l.discount != line.discount)):\n                    # In case of re-invoicing with different discount we try to calculate manually the\n                    # remaining amount to invoice\n                    amount = 0\n                    for l in inv_lines:\n                        if len(l.tax_ids.filtered(lambda tax: tax.price_include)) > 0:\n                            amount += l.tax_ids.compute_all(l.currency_id._convert(l.price_unit, line.currency_id, line.company_id, l.date or fields.Date.today(), round=False) * l.quantity)['total_excluded']\n                        else:\n                            amount += l.currency_id._convert(l.price_unit, line.currency_id, line.company_id, l.date or fields.Date.today(), round=False) * l.quantity\n\n                    amount_to_invoice = max(price_subtotal - amount, 0)\n                else:\n                    amount_to_invoice = price_subtotal - line.untaxed_amount_invoiced\n\n            line.untaxed_amount_to_invoice = amount_to_invoice\n\n    @api.depends('discount', 'price_total', 'product_uom_qty', 'qty_invoiced_posted')\n    def _compute_amount_to_invoice(self):\n        for line in self:\n            if line.product_uom_qty:\n                # The ordered quantity is what the customer committed to, delivered or not.\n                qty_to_invoice = line.product_uom_qty - line.qty_invoiced_posted\n                unit_price_total = line.price_total / line.product_uom_qty\n                line.amount_to_invoice = unit_price_total * qty_to_invoice\n            else:\n                line.amount_to_invoice = 0.0\n\n    @api.depends('order_id.partner_id', 'product_id')\n    def _compute_analytic_distribution(self):\n        for line in self:\n            if not line.display_type:\n                distribution = line.env['account.analytic.distribution.model']._get_distribution({\n                    \"product_id\": line.product_id.id,\n                    \"product_categ_id\": line.product_id.categ_id.id,\n                    \"partner_id\": line.order_id.partner_id.id,\n                    \"partner_category_id\": line.order_id.partner_id.category_id.ids,\n                    \"company_id\": line.company_id.id,\n                })\n                line.analytic_distribution = distribution or line.analytic_distribution\n\n    @api.depends('product_id', 'state', 'qty_invoiced', 'qty_delivered')\n    def _compute_product_updatable(self):\n        self.product_updatable = True\n        for line in self:\n            if (\n                line.is_downpayment\n                or line.state == 'cancel'\n                or line.state == 'sale' and (\n                    line.order_id.locked\n                    or line.qty_invoiced > 0\n                    or line.qty_delivered > 0\n                )\n            ):\n                line.product_updatable = False\n\n    @api.depends('state')\n    def _compute_product_uom_readonly(self):\n        for line in self:\n            # line.ids checks whether it's a new record not yet saved\n            line.product_uom_readonly = line.ids and line.state in ['sale', 'cancel']\n\n    #=== CONSTRAINT METHODS ===#\n\n    @api.constrains('combo_item_id')\n    def _check_combo_item_id(self):\n        \"\"\" `combo_item_id` should never be set manually. This constraint mainly serves to avoid\n        programming errors.\n        \"\"\"\n        for line in self:\n            linked_line = line._get_linked_line()\n            allowed_combo_items = linked_line.product_template_id.combo_ids.combo_item_ids\n            if line.combo_item_id and line.combo_item_id not in allowed_combo_items:\n                raise ValidationError(_(\n                    \"A sale order line's combo item must be among its linked line's available\"\n                    \" combo items.\"\n                ))\n            if line.combo_item_id and Спирався на документацію **Odoo 18.0** та код офіційної гілки Odoo `18.0` для перевірки технічних назв моделей. Демо-база партнера не була підключена. Оскільки документація не позначає кожну функцію як Community або Enterprise, функції, які треба перевірити саме в партнерській Community-базі, позначені окремо.

| Крок | Застосунок і модель Odoo | Дія | Відмінність від Lab 1 | Джерело перевірки |
|---|---|---|---|---|

Вказати назву закладу, контактну особу, відомі контакти й джерело ліда. Призначити salesperson і sales team. Ім’я контакту, телефон, email та конкретний менеджер не задані, тому їх потрібно лишити порожніми або заповнити після отримання даних. | Дані клієнтів веде CRM «КавоХаб»; Odoo CRM потрібна для аналізу й разового імпорту. | **4. Створити пропозицію на 10 кг кави й кавомолку зі знижкою 12%** | Sales — `sale.order`; рядки — `sale.order.line`; товари — `product.product` / `product.template` | Створити quotation, вказати клієнта, додати каву в кількості 10 кг і кавомолку (для прикладу — 1 шт). Увімкнути **Discounts** у Sales Settings і задати 12% у `Disc.%` або застосувати знижку до всіх рядків. Надіслати пропозицію. Підтверджувати її як замовлення слід після прийняття клієнтом і погодження знижки. | Lab 1 P2 вимагає погодження знижки понад 10% керівником продажів, а за його відсутності — директоркою. | [Створення пропозицій](https://www.odoo.com/documentation/18.0/applications/sales/sales/sales_quotations/create_quotations.html), [знижки Sales](https://www.odoo.com/documentation/18.0/applications/sales/sales/products_prices/prices/discounts.html), моделі [`sale.order`](https://github.com/odoo/odoo/blob/18.0/addons/sale/models/sale_order.py), [`sale.order.line`](https://github.com/odoo/odoo/blob/18.0/addons/sale/models/sale_order_line.py) |
| **5. Чи погоджується 12% автоматично?** | Sales — `sale.order`, `sale.order.line` | Документація описує введення знижки та звичайне підтвердження quotation як sales order, але не описує автоматичний approval за порогом понад 10%. **Висновок:** автоматичне погодження не підтверджено; потрібна окрема доробка/approval workflow для «КавоХаб», якщо в Community-базі партнера не встановлено окремий модуль. | Lab 1 P2 вимагає погодження керівником, блокування редагування знижки після запиту та відкликання запиту. Lab 2 наводить відсутність вбудованого погодження в Sales Community як приклад класифікації **Extend**. Це висновок з документації та методички, а не тест партнерської бази. | [Знижки в Odoo Sales 18](https://www.odoo.com/documentation/18.0/applications/sales/sales/products_prices/prices/discounts.html), [методичка Lab 2](https://github.com/PavelAnko/corporate-software-systems-lessons/blob/master/lab-02.md) |
| **6. Зарезервувати й оформити доставку** | Inventory — `stock.picking`; рухи — `stock.move`, `stock.move.line`; замовлення — `sale.order` | Для типу операції доставки вибрати **At Confirmation**, **Manually** або **Before scheduled date**. У delivery order вказати фактичну кількість і натиснути **Validate**. Для часткової доставки зафіксувати відправлену кількість і створити backorder на залишок. | Lab 1 P4/С2 вимагає обмежити резерв 24 годинами. Документовані методи Odoo задають, **коли** резервується товар, але не підтверджують автоматичне звільнення через 24 години. Для цього правила потрібна доробка/автоматизація. У CRM «КавоХаб» кожна успішна повна або часткова доставка має породжувати окрему `inventory.shipment.delivered`; повтори не враховуються. | [Методи резервування](https://www.odoo.com/documentation/18.0/applications/inventory_and_mrp/inventory/shipping_receiving/reservation_methods.html), [операції доставки й кількості](https://www.odoo.com/documentation/18.0/applications/inventory_and_mrp/inventory/shipping_receiving/daily_operations/receipts_delivery_two_steps.html), [часткова доставка/backorder](https://www.odoo.com/documentation/18.0/applications/inventory_and_mrp/inventory/shipping_receiving/setup_configuration/multipack.html), модель [`stock.picking`](https://github.com/odoo/odoo/blob/18.0/addons/stock/models/stock_picking.py) |
| **7. Створити й провести рахунок за доставлене** | Invoicing/Accounting — `account.move`; рядки — `account.move.line`; Sales — `sale.order` | У Sales Settings вибрати **Invoice what is delivered**. Для вже створених продуктів окремо перевірити або змінити invoicing policy в картці продукту. Після валідації delivery order натиснути **Create Invoice** у sales order, перевірити чернетку й провести рахунок. За часткової доставки рахунок формується на фактичну доставлену кількість. | Lab 1 відрізняє реальну покупку від замовленої чи лише відправленої кількості. Для ризику низького обсягу CRM «КавоХаб» сумує каву в проведених рахунках мінус кредит-ноти; `lastOrderAt` окремо бере дату успішної доставки. | [Політика рахунків](https://www.odoo.com/documentation/18.0/applications/sales/sales/invoicing/invoicing_policy.html), [Sales → Delivery → Invoice](https://www.odoo.com/documentation/18.0/applications/finance/accounting/customer_invoices/overview.html), модель [`account.move`](https://github.com/odoo/odoo/blob/18.0/addons/account/models/account_move.py) |
| **8. Часткова й повна оплата; кредит-нота на 1 кг** | Платіж — `account.payment`; рахунок і кредит-нота — `account.move` | На рахунку натиснути **Pay**, внести часткову суму й лишити залишок відкритим; потім зареєструвати оплату залишку. Банківську виписку імпортувати CSV і звірити транзакції. Для кредит-ноти відкрити рахунок → **Credit Note**, вказати причину й дату, змінити кількість кави на 1 кг і підтвердити документ. | Lab 1 Б2: частина платежів надходить без номера рахунку, один платіж може покривати кілька рахунків; потрібна ручна обробка неоднозначних збігів.
